description_html:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY  

We are looking for a talented Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a drive to build quality products.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development.

Based in Cologne, you'll be a key member of the Engineering team building IMPECT's customer-facing Scouting and Analytics platforms. You'll develop backend services and frontend features that help football clubs explore our data, evaluate players and teams, and analyse performance. Your work will span data-rich interfaces, interactive visualisations, integrated video tools, and workflows that support scouting and match analysis. Working closely with Product and fellow engineers, you'll translate customer needs into intuitive, reliable applications and help improve their performance and scalability as our platform grows. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll contribute to technical decisions and take ownership of features from initial design through to delivery, shaping the products our customers use every day.

We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance.  Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Build and maintain Angular web applications
  • Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications
  • Design and implement database schema
  • Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications
  • Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems.
  • Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features
  • Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.
  • Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • At least 5 years of software development experience.
  • Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular
  • Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin Java.
  • Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema
  • Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications
  • Experience with Git code management is highly desired.

Other Requirements:

  • Very strong attention to detail.
  • Proven self-starter.
  • Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to prioritise and a "can-do" attitude.
  • Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication in order to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures, and build your global awareness and capability 
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better.  There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)

Language requirement: fluency in German or Spanish

Location: Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA

Employment: 18-month FTC with view to extend

 

About the role: 

We're hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You'll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You'll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren't there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you'll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.

 

Key Responsibilities:

New Business and Client Engagement

description_html:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us build and operate the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.

Get to know our Engineering team, what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions(internally called EventBus) and future streaming platform technologies. These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Design, build and operate large-scale event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, EventBus and related streaming platforms.

  • Debug complex distributed systems issues, including performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production reliability challenges.

  • Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.

  • Contribute to incident response, operational readiness and continuous improvement for Tier-0 infrastructure.

  • Partner closely with EventBus, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams across US and EU regions.

  • Help shape the long-term architecture and evolution of Deliveroo's event streaming platform.

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.

  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.

  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable production systems.

  • Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.

  • Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

 

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.

  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.

  • Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.

  • Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.

  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale.

 

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🌎 A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create
Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

title: Facilities Architect
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Focused
description_html:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Focused Energy is developing its flagship fusion facility at Biblis, Germany — and this role sits at the heart of making it happen. As Facility Development Lead, you will be the senior bridge between our engineering teams, the RWE/Biblis site stakeholders, German design and permitting requirements, utilities providers, and external planning partners.

Without this role, Biblis development would slow down, RWE discussions would be less focused, and facility requirements could become fragmented. Engineering leaders would carry too much of the facility strategy and stakeholder interface burden. You will remove that risk by owning the facility development direction end-to-end.

Your primary mission: turn Focused Energy’s technical and strategic needs for Biblis into a clear, realistic, and executable facility development plan — and keep it moving.

What You'll Do

Define the Biblis facility development direction by translating FE’s technical

requirements into a phased, executable site, building, and infrastructure plan.

• Lead the RWE and site-owner interface on facility planning, infrastructure constraints,

utilities, and long-term site expansion, collaborating closely with the Senior

Construction Project Manager.

• Translate engineering’s needs into facility requirements across lasers, targetry,

diagnostics, controls, cleanrooms, electrical systems, safety and operations.

• Drive German design and permitting strategy by identifying required approvals,

regulatory constraints, fire protection requirements, and risk assessment.

• Coordinate external architects, planners, consultants and utilities partners, ensuring

their output is aligned with FE’s technical roadmap and decision needs.

• Enable senior decision-making by maintaining a clear, current picture of facility options,

risks, assumptions, dependencies, and cost/schedule implications, so engineering

leadership can act with confidence and without delay.

Who You Are

Must-haves

  • Experience leading or shaping complex facility, industrial building, infrastructure, or technical site development in Germany.

  • Working knowledge of German building, planning, permitting, and compliance processes.

  • Ability to translate technical engineering needs into facility, layout, infrastructure, and utility requirements.

  • Ability to manage external architects, planners, consultants, or engineering service providers.

  • Strong stakeholder interface experience with site owners, authorities, landlords, utilities, or senior external partners.

  • Professional German and English language capability.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with energy, nuclear-adjacent, research, cleanroom, laser, laboratory, or high-tech industrial facilities.

  • Direct experience with RWE, grid operators, utilities providers, or major German site owners.

  • Experience with phased campus or brownfield site development.

  • Familiarity with power infrastructure, backup power, grid connection, HVAC, cooling, cleanrooms, or specialist utilities.

  • Architectural, civil, building services, industrial engineering, or related professional qualification.

  • Experience supporting investment cases, board-level decision papers, or strategic facility roadmaps.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

description_html:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

As a (Senior) Software Engineer, you’ll build core features for our flagship product, turning complex tax scenarios into simple, reliable experiences. You’ll bring a builder-first mindset: staying close to customer problems, using AI and modern engineering tools to move from idea to impact quickly, and taking ownership of outcomes—not just code.

You’ll work hands-on in a cross-functional team and bring deep expertise in either frontend or backend engineering, while collaborating effectively across the stack. You’ll help us raise the bar for scalable design, quality, maintainability, and AI-first software development.

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Partner with product management, design, and engineering to understand customer problems, shape pragmatic solutions, and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Own work end to end—from discovery and technical design through implementation, release, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Turn ambiguity into action, make sound trade-offs, and deliver valuable increments without compromising long-term maintainability.

  • Contribute to technical direction and strategy in support of the long-term product vision.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Critically evaluate, validate, and troubleshoot AI-generated output, using effective prompting and appropriate safeguards rather than accepting results at face value.

  • Share effective AI-assisted development practices, encourage responsible experimentation, and help teammates improve how they use AI tools.

  • Improve developer experience through tools, automation, and engineering practices that enable reliable, frequent delivery.

  • Collaborate across product and platform teams, and contribute to an environment where people learn, grow, give constructive feedback, and raise challenges safely.

Your profile:

  • Professional software engineering experience (React, Node.js) and designing reliable backend services and APIs. Experience with React Native experience is a plus.

  • Able to work effectively across system boundaries and collaborate with engineers outside your primary specialism.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Able to evaluate and troubleshoot AI-generated output, use effective prompting where relevant, and share practical learnings with teammates.

  • Experience working with a public cloud environment such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.

  • Familiarity with DevOps concepts and practices, including CI/CD, observability, and operating software in production.

  • Understanding of core application and backend concepts such as authentication, databases, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and API integrations.

  • A builder-first, pragmatic approach: You turn customer problems into shipped outcomes. You take initiative, test and learn quickly, and make clear trade-offs between speed, quality, maintainability, and risk.

  • Passion for writing maintainable, elegant code and continuously improving how software is built.

  • A collaborative, positive attitude and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively.

  • You have a builder mindset. You thrive in environments where things are still taking shape, take initiative to move ideas forward, and find ways to create impact even when the path isn't fully defined.

  • You embrace trying things out over waiting for perfect conditions, ship early to learn fast, and treat iteration as progress.

 

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal tech meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

description_html:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is looking for a Senior Information Security Manager to strengthen our Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) function. You'll own the day-to-day operation of our information security and compliance program, with a strong focus on ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, and a bonus if you bring HIPAA or BSI C5 experience to the table.

This isn't a "gatekeeper" role. We're a SaaS scale-up, and our product teams move fast. We need someone who understands risk well enough to take calculated ones, someone who can say "yes, and here's how we do it safely" instead of defaulting to "no." You'll be the person who keeps compliance moving at the speed of the business, not the person who slows it down.

You'll be part of our Information Security team, sitting within the broader Security track alongside the IT Security team, both under our Head of Security. You'll work closely with your teammates in Information Security and IT Security to make sure security and compliance work hand in hand rather than in separate lanes.

 

Your responsibilities

Program ownership

  • Own and continuously improve our Information Security Management System (ISMS), keeping it aligned with ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and, where relevant, HIPAA and BSI C5

  • Maintain and mature our risk register, policy library, vendor/third-party risk assessments, and control monitoring

Audits & evidence

  • Act as a hands-on participant in audits, working directly with auditors, control owners, and leadership to prepare, execute, and close out certification and attestation cycles efficiently rather than through brute force

  • Build and refine evidence collection processes using automation and GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or similar), reducing manual overhead and audit fatigue across the company

  • Design and roll out a model where product and engineering teams own their evidence throughout the control lifecycle, rather than compliance chasing people down before every audit

Risk & business partnership

  • Assess risk pragmatically: identify real security and compliance exposure, size it accurately, and make calculated calls that unblock product and engineering teams

  • Partner with engineering, product, IT, People, and Legal to embed security and compliance requirements into existing workflows rather than bolting them on afterward

  • Track regulatory and customer-driven compliance requirements — new customer security questionnaires, evolving frameworks — and translate them into practical, actionable controls

Reporting

  • Report on the state of the security and compliance program to stakeholders and leadership, including audit readiness, open risks, and remediation progress

 

Qualities we look for

  • 3-5 years of experience in information security, GRC, or compliance roles, ideally at a SaaS company, and ideally at scaleup pace and scale

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs and audits, from control design through evidence collection to certification

  • Experience with HIPAA and/or BSI C5 is a strong plus

  • Practical experience with GRC/evidence automation tooling such as Vanta (or equivalent), including building smooth, low-friction processes around it

  • A track record of building processes that shift evidence ownership to the teams generating the evidence, rather than centralizing it all in compliance

  • Sound risk judgment: comfortable making calculated, defensible risk decisions to keep product teams unblocked, rather than reflexively blocking

  • Strong stakeholder management skills; able to work credibly with engineers, product managers, and leadership without becoming an obstacle

  • Fluent English and German language skills at C1 level (or close by) are required

  • Clear, structured communicator who can translate compliance requirements into language engineering and product teams actually act on

 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-HK1

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: GTM Enablement Intern
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Peec AI
description_html:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $15M ARR, with an 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

We're looking for a GTM Enablement Intern to join us for 3 months and help make sure everything our customers and prospects see from Peec is high-quality, accurate, and on-brand. You'll work directly with our GTM Enablement Manager and support Growth, Sales, Customer Experience, and Design on decks and offers, case studies, and competitive intelligence.

This is a hands-on role, not a shadowing one. You'll ship real work that goes in front of customers from your first weeks. We use AI to move faster, and we'll expect you to as well, while holding a high bar for quality. If something looks generic or rushed, we want you to be the one who notices.

What you'll do

  • Update and refine sales decks, one-pagers, and offers so they stay current, consistent, and pixel-perfect

  • Support our case study program: prepare interviews, draft customer stories, and help turn results into polished assets

  • Track competitor launches, pricing, and messaging, and summarize what's new in a clear, usable way for our teams

  • Help build and test workflows and automations that save the GTM team time

  • Learn our product and the AI search space quickly, and help translate new features into materials

  • Take on ad hoc projects across Growth, Sales, and CX as priorities shift

What we're looking for

  • Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor's or Master's program, ideally in business, marketing, communications, design, or a related field

  • A strong eye for aesthetics: you notice when spacing, fonts, or colors are off, and you care about getting the details right

  • Comfortable working in Google Slides, Figma, or similar

  • Curious about AI and how people use it, with good judgment on when AI output is good enough and when it isn't

  • Quick learner who can pick up a technical product and explain it simply

  • Organized and reliable: you manage several requests at once and follow through

  • Excellent written English

Bonus points

  • Previous internship or working student experience at a startup or tech company

  • A portfolio, side project, or anything you've made that shows your taste

  • Some exposure to SEO, GEO, or marketing tech

  • Experience with building lightweight automations using Hubspot, Clay, and Claude

  • Fluent German

What we offer

  • Real ownership and work that ships to customers

  • Direct mentorship from our GTM team

  • Collaborative, high-energy in-office work environment

  • A front-row seat to building a new market category

Compensation: €3K per month

  • • €3K per month

About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. About the role

We're looking for a GTM Enablement Specialist to make sure everything our customers and prospects see from Peec is high-quality, accurate, and on-brand. You'll sit between Growth, Sales, Customer Experience and design, and own the materials, stories, and market knowledge those teams rely on every day: decks and offers, case studies, and competitive intelligence.

This role is for someone who holds a high bar on craft and moves fast. We use AI to speed up our GTM work, and we expect you to do the same. We also expect you to be the person who catches generic, low-effort output before it reaches a customer. Our brand and our customer experience matter too much to ship anything less than excellent.

What you'll do

  • Own Peec's branded GTM materials: sales decks, offers, one-pagers, and proposal templates. Work with our Design team to keep them current, consistent, and pixel-perfect

  • Build our case study program with product marketing: identify the right customers with CX and Sales, run interviews, turn results into compelling stories, and get them in front of prospects

  • Run competitive intelligence: track what competitors ship and say, turn it into clear, practical resources our teams use in live deals, and flag what matters to Product and leadership

  • Build workflows and automations that speed up how GTM teams find, create, and use materials, using AI where it genuinely improves the result

  • Act as the connective tissue between Growth, Sales, and CX: gather what each team needs, align on priorities, and make sure everyone works from the same story

  • Learn our product and the AI search space deeply, and translate new features and market shifts into materials within days, not weeks

  • Decide what to work on first when ten teams need ten things, and build systems so the same request doesn't need to be solved twice

What we're looking for

  • 3–5 years in sales enablement, product marketing, GTM operations, or a similar role at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company

  • A strong eye for aesthetics: you notice misaligned elements, inconsistent fonts, and off-brand colors, and you know when something looks right. You don't need to be a designer, but you're comfortable making clean edits in Figma, or similar

  • Clear judgment on AI-generated content: you use AI to move faster, you know when it makes the work worse, and you push back when quality slips

  • Strong product sense: you pick up a technical product and a new market quickly and can explain both simply

  • Proven ability to prioritize and think in systems in a fast-moving environment, where priorities change weekly

  • Experience working across teams with different goals, and the communication skills to keep them aligned without slowing them down

  • Hands-on experience building workflows and automations

  • Excellent written English. You write clearly and cut anything that doesn't earn its place

Bonus points

  • Some exposure to SEO, GEO, or marketing tech, or the curiosity to get up to speed quickly

  • Experience running a customer story or case study program

  • Experience building competitive intelligence from scratch

  • Experience at an early-stage company during a period of rapid scale

  • Fluent German

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity: everyone at Peec owns a piece of the upside

  • Comprehensive benefits package

  • Collaborative, high-energy in-office work environment

  • Opportunity to make a significant impact and define a new market category

Compensation: €70K – €80K • Offers Equity

title: Performance Marketing Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at YAZIO
description_html:
HEY THERE!

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

 

As a Performance Marketing Manager, you'll be a key player in our user acquisition team, owning and optimizing high-performing campaigns across digital channels, including DSPs (e.g., Appier, Liftoff, Unity), paid social and search (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, ASA).

 

You'll put AI tools and automation to work cutting down on repetitive tasks, sharpening your insights and helping campaigns scale more efficiently. You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional teammates in creative, product and analytics to bring best-in-class growth strategies to life - with plenty of support along the way as you grow.

 

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

  • Launch, manage and scale user acquisition campaigns across one or more channels, with a focus on DSPs (e.g., AppLovin, Appier, Liftoff, Unity) and experience in other channels like Meta Ads, Google Ads, ASA, TikTok, and similar platforms

  • Analyze campaign performance, identify optimization opportunities and run structured tests to drive efficiency and impact

  • Use AI tools and automation to take repetitive tasks off your plate - from reporting to bulk campaign changes - so you can focus on strategy and results

  • Provide actionable insights to the creative team based on ad performance and user behavior data

  • Help spot measurement gaps and work with product, web and analytics teams to improve tracking and attribution

  • Support scalable workflows: naming conventions, tracking setup, reporting, knowledge documentation, etc.

  • Stay curious about MarTech and AI trends, and bring new tools or features to the team to continuously improve how we work

YOUR PROFILE

We know few candidates check every box below, but if you're excited about this role and bring most of what we're looking for, we'd still love to hear from you.

  • 2–5 years of experience managing and scaling user acquisition campaigns (e.g., Google Ads, Meta, ASA, TikTok, or DSPs like Appier or AppLovin)

  • A curious, analytical mindset - comfortable working with ROAS, CPA, conversion funnels and attribution data, or eager to build that muscle

  • Genuine interest in AI tools and automation, and how they can cut out repetitive work and improve campaign outcomes

  • Familiarity with attribution tools (GA4 and/or MMPs); DSP experience specifically is a plus

  • A structured, solution-oriented thinker who takes initiative and enjoys ownership

  • Team-oriented with excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

  • Nice to have: experience with campaign workflow or reporting automation (bulk tools, scripts, dashboards, SQL), and/or fluency in French or Dutch

 

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours—no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change—short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections—from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being—supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

 

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take Yazio to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

  • Your CV in English

  • A few lines (or a short video if you prefer) about who you are and why you want to work at Yazio

  • Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

title: Data Analytics Team Lead
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at YAZIO
description_html:
HEY THERE

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.

Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.

You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:

  • Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next

  • Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on

  • Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up

  • Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it

  • Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before

  • Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool

  • Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions

YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:

  • You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course

  • You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself

  • Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways

  • You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through

  • You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data

  • When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)

  • A strong statistics background

  • Dagster or Airflow for scheduling

  • Data catalogues like DataHub

 

OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:

  • Warehouse: Snowflake

  • Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster

  • Experimentation: GrowthBook

  • Self-service analytics: Omni

  • ML workflows: Prefect

  • GenAI: Claude

If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

  • Your CV in English

  • Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

description_html:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.


Your Role

As a Staff Frontend Engineer at bunch, you will shape the architecture, quality, and developer experience of the product surfaces our customers and internal teams rely on every day. You will work across product teams to make our frontend systems scalable, reliable, accessible, and fast — while helping engineers ship with clarity and confidence.

This is not only a delivery role. Your decisions will influence how frontend engineering at bunch evolves: the standards we adopt, the patterns we reuse, the quality bar we hold, and the way product, design, and engineering collaborate to build excellent user experiences.

How the role contributes to our vision

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our platform enables funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in turning complex workflows into intuitive, robust, and scalable product experiences. You will help ensure our frontend foundation enables rapid delivery across teams while maintaining high standards for usability, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

Top priorities

  1. Lead our migration from Svelte to React. Hold the architectural picture across both stacks, sequence the work against product delivery, and land it without stalling teams.

  2. Maintain and evolve our design system, together with the frontend guild, so product teams ship consistent, accessible UI faster.

  3. Support and guide frontend initiatives across teams, with the frontend guild — application architecture, performance, testing strategy, developer experience, and technical debt reduction — from diagnosis through measurable delivery.

  4. Be the bar raiser for UX and UI quality, raising the standard through design reviews, reusable patterns, mentoring, and thoughtful technical writing.

  5. Advance how we build with AI — find where agentic tooling genuinely improves engineering practice, and shape the codebase (module boundaries, API contracts, documentation) so it works well for people and agents alike.

Your first 90 days

  • 30 days: map the frontend architecture, product domains, design system, team workflows, and the main bottlenecks affecting delivery and quality.

  • 60 days: publish a structured problem analysis and proposal for one cross-team frontend initiative with clear trade-offs, stakeholders, and success measures.

  • 90 days: lead a systemic improvement from kickoff to measurable progress across teams, while helping Senior Engineers grow through collaboration, reviews, and shared ownership.

About you

  • Track record — You have already operated at Staff scope, with or without the title, and have shipped systemic frontend or product-engineering improvements across multiple teams. People listen to you because of what you have delivered, how clearly you think, and how effectively you collaborate.

  • Frontend craft — Deep expertise in modern frontend engineering, with strong command of TypeScript, component architecture, state management, design systems, accessibility, performance, testing, and maintainable application architecture.

  • AI-native practice — You use AI coding tools daily and have gone past autocomplete into agentic workflows. You have a considered view on where they genuinely help, where they don't, and what a codebase needs to be a good place to work in with agents.

  • Product judgment — You care about the user experience as much as the technical solution. You can translate ambiguous workflows and business constraints into pragmatic, elegant product experiences.

  • Systems thinking — You are comfortable reasoning across frontend, backend, APIs, infrastructure, observability, security, and compliance when the problem requires it.

  • Operating style — You think in quarters and years, not only sprints. You drive cross-team change through credibility, clear writing, architectural reasoning, and strong stakeholder alignment — not through authority.

  • Collaborative Leadership: A proactive relationship-builder who can set technical direction and influence without formal authority, manage diverse stakeholders and build alignment on difficult technical decisions, while mentoring engineers.

  • Language — Fluent English, written and spoken. You can make complex technical decisions legible to engineers, product partners, design partners, and leadership alike.

Our tech stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Svelte — we are consolidating on React, and this role leads that migration.

  • Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js

  • Database: MySQL

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS

  • Source Control & CI/CD: GitHub

  • Authentication: FusionAuth, Okta

  • Internal Tools: Retool

  • Messaging: Twilio, SendGrid

  • Forms: Tally

title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Moss
description_html:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process.

This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both.

How we're set up

Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do.

We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves.

What you'll own

  • Feasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible.

  • The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours.

  • Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself.

  • A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so.

  • Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad.

  • Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth.

  • Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it.

How we expect leaders to operate

  • Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems.

  • Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line.

  • End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally.

  • No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it.

  • Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against.

  • Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions.

Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too.

What you bring

  • 4 to 6+ years in engineering management, with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers.

  • A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical.

  • Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why.

  • Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully.

  • Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery.

  • Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it.

  • Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices: code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing.

Strong pluses

  • Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build.

  • Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation.

  • Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it.

What this role is, and isn't

It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here.

About Moss

At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations.

 

Your tasks:

  • Evolve, expand and maintain our component libraries on all our platforms (iOS, Android and Web): Angular, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI fed by a shared design system.

  • Partner closely with our UI/UX designers on component APIs, naming, states, and variants, keeping our code in sync with our Figma library - closing the gap between what is designed and what ships.

  • Define the system's architecture: theming and brand layering, versioning, releases, and a contribution model that invites our domain teams in rather than shutting them out.

  • Maintain living documentation (e.g. Storybook) and drive adoption through pairing, reviews, and migration paths.

  • Make accessibility and responsive behavior built-in properties of our components, not an afterthought.

  • Adopt agentic coding practices and use AI coding agents to accelerate development, while maintaining ownership of technical decisions, code quality, and outcomes.

What you offer us:

  • Several years as a frontend or mobile engineer, including hands-on ownership of a design system or shared component library used by multiple teams.

  • TypeScript and Angular skills or comparable depth in another modern framework / library and a clear willingness to go all in on Angular plus a sharp instinct for component API design.

  • Hands-on native UI development with Kotlin/Jetpack Compose or Swift/SwiftUI. You will author native components yourself. Strong expertise in one platform, combined with an interest in developing a working knowledge of the other, is perfectly fine.

  • Experience with design tokens and theming multi-brand environments: building one system that carries several brands without forking.

  • A strong grasp of responsive and adaptive design and of accessibility standards, and the habit of verifying both in practice.

  • A product mindset toward internal tooling, you treat the design system and component libraries as a product with users and measure success by adoption. You enjoy enabling other teams and building consensus across engineering and design.

  • A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact.

  • Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development.

  • Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results.

  • Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance.

  • Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool.

  • Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security.

  • Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany.

  • Quarterly company events, along with regular team activities and informal gatherings, a favorite being our Healthy Tuesday lunches or Treat Thursdays in the office!

title: Warehouse Trainer / Trainer Logistik (m/w/d)
description_html:
At Knuspr, speed matters. Quality matters. But none of it works without people who know what they’re doing from day one. That’s where our trainers come in.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Trainer who will help new colleagues settle in fast, learn the job properly, and grow into confident, high-performing team members. This role is part onboarding, part coaching, part culture-building — and a big part of what makes our warehouse teams work well together. If you enjoy working with people, teaching by example, and helping others improve every day, this is your opportunity to shape our operational performance directly on the floor.

Why this role is exciting

  • Direct impact: You’ll have a direct influence on how quickly new employees become productive, confident, and successful in their daily work.

  • On-the-ground leadership: You’ll help shape team culture right on the warehouse floor — not from behind a desk.

  • Key operational partnership: You’ll work closely with team managers as a trusted partner for onboarding, development, and floor performance.

  • Diverse daily work: You’ll support both newcomers and existing team members across various departments, making every day different.

  • Real ownership: People will rely on you directly for guidance, clarity, and practical support.

What you’ll do

  • Onboarding & Training: Coordinate and lead onboarding for new warehouse employees across different departments and operational processes.

  • Coaching & Feedback: Provide regular feedback, motivate employees, identify individual training needs, and build practical improvement plans.

  • Material & Process Improvement: Support the development of training materials and help roll out new warehouse processes so teams understand and execute them correctly.

  • Quality & Standards: Ensure warehouse safety rules, operational guidelines, and quality standards are followed consistently.

  • Management Alignment: Partner with managers to evaluate training progress, track effectiveness, and continuously improve training methods based on floor needs.

  • Culture & Floor Support: Act as the primary go-to person for daily floor questions and serve as a role model for Rohlik culture, teamwork, and customer orientation.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience: At least 1 year of experience in training, coaching, or onboarding; background in a warehouse, logistics, or operational environment is a plus.

  • Hands-on Mindset: Open-minded, self-driven, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Communication & People Skills: Strong communicator with a natural ability to connect with people, offer constructive feedback, and remain calm under pressure.

  • Structured Approach: Well-organized, attentive to detail, and genuinely passionate about helping others succeed.

  • Tech-savvy: Comfortable using digital tools, apps, and new workplace technologies.

  • Languages: Professional working proficiency in either English or German is required. Additional languages (e.g., Romanian, Russian, Polish) are a strong advantage.

What we offer

  • Real impact: Your work directly drives floor efficiency, team performance, and our company's overall results.

  • Fast execution: Good ideas are implemented almost immediately — without waiting for approval from distant headquarters or getting stuck in corporate bureaucracy.

  • Innovation-driven culture: We don't just follow industry trends; we aim to set them.

  • Growth & Reward: Fair compensation, continuous opportunities for professional growth, and clear career paths.

  • Team & Culture: A supportive, energetic team and legendary company events.

title: Staplerfahrer / Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik – Schubmast (m/w/d)

description_html:
Staplerfahrer / Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik – Schubmast (m/w/d) Garching bei München (Gewerbegebiet) | Logistik / Operations | Vollzeit

Knuspr ist Teil der Rohlik Gruppe – und wir verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen Lebensmittel einkaufen. Unser Herz schlägt für frische, hochwertige Produkte und eine blitzschnelle Lieferung direkt an die Haustür. Für unser modernes Logistikzentrum in Garching bei München suchen wir verlässliche Staplerfahrer (m/w/d), die im Hochregallager den Überblick behalten und für einen reibungslosen Materialfluss sorgen.

In dieser Rolle bewegst du täglich unsere Waren, versorgst die Packstrecken und stellst sicher, dass die LKW pünktlich und sicher be- und entladen werden. Wenn du nachweisbare Praxis auf dem Schubmaststapler mitbringst und in einem dynamischen, wachsenden Umfeld anpacken willst, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Mitten im Geschehen: Du bist das Rückgrat unseres Warenlagers und sorgst direkt dafür, dass unsere Kommissionierung ohne Unterbrechung arbeiten kann.

  • Moderne Logistik: Du arbeitest in einem hochdynamischen E-Food-Umfeld mit modernem Warenwirtschaftssystem und professionellen Flurförderzeugen.

  • Transparente Verdienstmöglichkeiten: Ein verlässliches Fixgehalt ab 2.600 € brutto plus volle Bezahlung jeder geleisteten Überstunde.

  • Starkes Benefit-Paket: Tägliche Zuschüsse für Verpflegung und Anfahrt sowie attraktive Mitarbeiter-Mischrabatte bei Knuspr und externen Partnern.

Was du bei uns tust

  • Warentransport & Einlagerung: Innerbetriebliche Verräumung und Umlagerung von Lebensmitteln und Materialien im und aus dem Hochregallager mittels Flurförderzeugen.

  • Versorgung der Produktion: Pünktliche Belieferung der Kommissionierungsstrecke mit den benötigten Produkten.

  • Verladetätigkeiten: Fachgerechtes und sicheres Be- und Entladen von LKW.

  • Systemführung: Erfassung und Buchung der Warenbewegungen im internen Warenwirtschaftssystem.

Was du mitbringst

  • Qualifikation & Fahrpraxis: Ein gültiger Staplerschein sowie nachweisbare, praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit dem Schubmaststapler.

  • Hochregalerfahrung: Erste praktische Erfahrung bei der Ein- und Auslagerung in Hochregalsystemen.

  • Erfahrung in der Logistik: Vorkenntnisse in der Kommissionierung oder im allgemeinen Lagerbereich.

  • Schichtbereitschaft: Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 3-Schicht-System (inklusive Samstagsarbeit).

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse für die Abstimmung im Team und die Arbeit mit den Systemen.

Was wir bieten

  • Fair Reward: Attraktives monatliches Fixgehalt ab 2.600 € brutto sowie volle Bezahlung geleisteter Überstunden.

  • Tägliche Zuschüsse: Zusätzlich 9,00 € Essenszulage sowie 5,00 € Fahrtkostenzuschlag pro Arbeitstag.

  • Gutscheine & Rabatte: 2x jährlich ein Gutschein in Höhe von je 300,00 € sowie ein Knuspr Xtra Account mit 10 % Rabatt als Knuspr Credits (Cashback).

  • Corporate Benefits: Tolle Rabatte über CorporateBenefits (Fitness, Reisen, Tickets, Shopping u. v. m.).

  • Teamgeist: Ein kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld in einem zukunftssicheren E-Commerce-Unternehmen.

title: Head of Warehouse Projects
description_html:
At Rohlik, we own our end-to-end operations — from in-house technology and automated distribution centers to last-mile delivery. Delivering thousands of products same-day requires an operational backbone built on advanced warehouse automation, goods-to-person (G2P) systems, and highly efficient intralogistics.

The Automation department leads large-scale warehouse projects across the Group, enabling safe, high-performing, and customer-centric fulfillment operations in all our markets. As Head of Warehouse Projects, you will own the delivery execution of major CapEx implementation projects — from retrofits and G2P integrations in legacy sites to full layout rollouts for new expansion sites across Europe.

You are the single point of accountability for bringing approved designs to life. Taking an signed-off operational layout, you will drive the entire program through site readiness, vendor management, budget control, and commissioning — delivering fully operational sites on time, on budget, and ready for local teams.

Why this role is exciting

  • Single point of ownership: You own the delivery execution end-to-end — holding ultimate accountability for whether complex, multi-million euro automation projects land on time and perform as expected.

  • Cutting-edge automation: Direct hands-on delivery of large-scale CapEx projects involving advanced goods-to-person (G2P/AS-RS) systems, conveyors, racking, and automated material handling.

  • European expansion scope: Play a central role in scaling Rohlik’s operational footprint across multiple European countries.

  • High organizational visibility: Interface directly with leadership across Automation, Engineering, Procurement, Facilities, and Operations.

  • High-impact execution: Transform theoretical engineering designs into fully functioning, high-throughput fulfillment hubs.

What you will own and deliver

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the execution of warehouse implementation projects (fit-outs, retrofits, and new site layouts) from project kickoff through commissioning, go-live, and operational handover.

  • Program & Schedule Management: Drive project plans, schedules, budgets, resourcing, and critical-path milestones, taking accountability for keeping all deliverables on track.

  • Vendor & Site Governance: Manage external contractors, equipment vendors, and integrators on-site, ensuring quality standards and delivery commitments are met.

  • Cross-Functional Integration: Coordinate with Solution Design, Automation, Procurement, Facilities, and Operations to translate designs into built assets — actively resolving technical and scheduling conflicts as they arise.

  • Risk Management & Escalation: Identify project dependencies and risks early, maintaining structured RACI matrices and resolving blockers proactively.

  • Testing & Operational Readiness: Lead commissioning, testing, and operational sign-off, ensuring clear handover, ongoing maintenance ownership, and troubleshooting protocols for local teams.

  • Stakeholder Reporting: Provide clear, structured project status, risk, and financial variance reporting to leadership and project stakeholders.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of experience leading large-scale CapEx delivery projects in warehouse automation, material handling, or industrial manufacturing.

  • Engineering degree (Industrial, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or a related technical field).

  • Technical literacy in automation: Solid practical understanding of material handling systems, conveyors, racking, and goods-to-person (G2P / AS-RS) technologies to effectively manage vendors and engineering partners.

  • Proven delivery leadership: Exceptional organizational skills with a track record of running complex critical paths, project budgets, and multi-vendor environments.

  • Strong communication & presence: Clear, confident presentation skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and direct external vendors.

  • Hands-on, ownership mindset: Highly proactive approach to anticipating risks and stepping into operational details to keep projects moving.

  • Willingness to travel: Flexibility for regular international travel across our European site network.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Project Management Certification (PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA Level C+, or equivalent).

  • Background in e-commerce, retail fulfillment, or high-throughput logistics automation.

  • Familiarity with next-generation logistics robotics and emerging warehouse technologies.

What’s in it for you

  • Fair pay, transparent, stable compensation A strong fixed salary with clear rules. No bonus politics. Great work is rewarded openly and fairly.

  • Good food options, fresh, every day Enjoy subsidised meals/fresh food options in the office and regular refreshments like drinks, fruit, and snacks that keep you energized.

  • Life beyond work, hybrid work & real flexibility Three days in the office and the rest where it works best for you. Take time off when you need it with paid vacation days above statutory and flexible scheduling.

  • Grow with Knuspr every day - we move fast, and so can you. Learn, experiment, and take ownership from day one. Every challenge is a chance to grow.

  • Recognition & community - Your impact is seen and appreciated. You can celebrate colleagues through Bonusly peer-recognition credits and feel supported by a team that works hard and wins together.

  • Health & wellbeing - Access to our UNIQA private insurance option and supportive wellbeing culture, keeping you healthy inside and outside of work.

  • Mobility & convenience - Company car available for selected management-level roles and fuel support for regular WH travel.

  • Premium membership - Free Knuspr Premium membership with exclusive benefits.

  • Referral rewards - Recommend great people and get rewarded through our group referral program.

  • Team spirit - We organize team events, celebrations, and moments to connect because work is better when we win together.
