title: Knit - Research Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Eleve Talent
description_html:
Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.


Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success

  • Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success

  • Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities

  • Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs

  • Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs

  • Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers

  • Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output

  • Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision in getting to stakeholder ready reports

Required Skills & Experiences:

  • Must have 5+ years of market research experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment.

  • Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus.

  • Proven track record of owning and supporting client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes successfully in environments with competing priorities, multiple research projects on at a given time, and simultaneous internal business demands.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

  • Are 1% better every day: We approach situations with a growth mindset and ask, “How can we make the business better?” and “What would it take?”

  • Play to win: We set audacious goals and push ourselves to achieve them with a bias towards action (When we see a need, we take initiative, and hold ourselves accountable to seeing it through).

  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Identify what has the biggest impact and prioritize to focus on it.

title: Endear - Account Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Eleve Talent
description_html:
About Us

Endear is building the first modern CRM for retail teams. We empower brands to drive more in-store sales by giving their retail teams AI-powered tools to have 10x more personalized, human conversations with customers. Despite retail being 6x larger than eCommerce, brick-and-mortar retail has been largely overlooked by the technology industry. We're changing that by enabling thousands of salespeople to leverage customer data in meaningful ways.

Founded 5 years ago, Endear has demonstrated strong product-market fit and reached profitability multiple times. Our platform was built from the ground up by technical leaders who have scaled data platforms to hundreds of millions of users and been at startups from early-stage through IPO. We make measured, high-conviction decisions at every milestone to ensure long-term success while realizing our massive potential in the retail market.

Our Work Environment

  • Remote-first culture built on trust and autonomy

  • Small, highly effective team (20-ish employees)

  • Fast-paced environment with shifting priorities

  • High-ownership culture where outcomes matter

  • Collaborative atmosphere that values learning and teaching

About the Role

We are seeking an account manager with a passion for helping our existing customers in a variety of ways to ensure their long term success with Endear. Our dream candidate is self-motivated and has an entrepreneur-like attitude towards their work. In other words, you like owning your process and the results that follow. You have a solutions-first approach to helping customers, with an eye on how support can result in upsells, referrals, and expansion

What You'll Own

  • Develop strong relationships with customers to ensure their success with Endear.

  • Perform customer trainings and onboardings with screenshare app walkthroughs and Q&A’s.

  • Periodically check in on account health & performance to spot any potential drop offs in adoption.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the performance of customer accounts through strategic guidance, problem solving, and providing needed materials.

  • Guide customers through the expansion/renewal process.

  • Develop resources and assets both video and written to improve customer success at Endear.

  • Work cross-functionally with product and marketing to ensure two-way feedback opportunities between your accounts and the corporate team

  • Act as an additional support system for sales team for smaller sales opportunities

  • Maintain an active role in customer support over chat, email, and phone when needed

Why This Role Matters

In this role, you will have a direct impact on the growth of Endear and will be involved in shaping the future of Account Management at Endear. You will be responsible for owning the relationships with key customer accounts, onboarding new customers, and improving the overall adoption, success, and expansion across Endear.

You will work closely with our tight-knit sales team including the VP of Sales, Account Executives, and Account Managers to rapidly develop your skillset. Additionally, you'll interact directly with the founding team including key department stakeholders across marketing and product. The right person for this role has experience in SaaS sales or account management and a passion for working in start-up environments; Familiarity and interest in the retail industry is a plus!

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years experience in account management for a B2B SaaS (Software-as-a-Service) company.

  • Experience working with retail businesses is a plus!

  • Comfortable working at a 100% remote company.

  • You're excited about the challenges that come with working for a small start-up company. (We all wear a lot of hats here!)

  • Never afraid to question the status quo, you take actions to solve a problem first, and only stop to ask questions or for feedback later.

  • You enjoy working in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment with the ability to self-manage and prioritize tasks.

  • You’re eager to learn and grow beyond this role by having an "all hands on deck" attitude.

Benefits

  • Cash compensation starting between $60-70K (pending experience) + bonus opportunities

  • Comprehensive healthcare including dental and vision

  • Home office or co-working space stipend

  • Flexible PTO with unlimited vacation days

  • Opportunity to shape the future of retail technology

Compensation: $60K – $70K • Offers Bonus

title: Consumer Insights & Strategy Partner
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Gen Digital
description_html:
Consumer Insights & Strategy Lead
London - Hybrid (3 days per week in the office)

About Gen

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate - leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career - from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You'll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.

If this sounds like you, we'd love you to be part of Gen.

How We Work

Our hybrid work style (3 days in the London office) gives us the face-to-face time to have creative conversations, meaningful meetings, make quick decisions and build relationships. And it's flexible enough to give you the space to do your best work.

Consumer Insights & Strategy Partner

The team

The Insights & Strategy team creates deep organizational understanding of our customers, markets and competitors so we can develop customer-centric products, services and communications that drive business growth.

We bring together different research disciplines and synthesize insights from across data sources, to tell coherent customer stories and ground decisions in evidence across Marketing, Product and Commercial teams.

Role summary

The Consumer Insights & Strategy Partner is a senior individual contributor who acts as a strategic advisor to segment and brand leadership for either Cyber Safety (Norton & Avast) or Trust-based Solutions (LifeLock & MoneyLion).

Their primary responsibility is not to generate research, but to help the business make better decisions. They connect customer understanding, market dynamics, competitive context and commercial performance to shape growth strategy, portfolio choices, proposition development and customer experience priorities.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy, customer insight and stakeholder leadership. You will:

  • Sit as a virtual member of the segment/brand leadership team, bringing the voice of the customer into key decisions.

  • Frame and scope the critical questions the business needs to answer.

  • Synthesize diverse inputs into clear, actionable narratives that influence direction.

  • Shape and prioritise the learning agenda for your segment in partnership with the wider Insight team.

Success is measured by the quality of business decisions influenced, not the volume of research delivered.

Key responsibilities

  1. Strategic business partnering

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the Segment Lead / Brand Lead and their virtual leadership team on segment strategy, performance, customer base and competitive context for your business segment.

  • Frame and refine critical business questions (e.g., portfolio choices, proposition direction, target audiences, pricing/packaging, experience priorities).

  • Bring a customer- and evidence-centred perspective into business planning, roadmap discussions and major investment or trade-off decisions.

  • Represent the voice of the customer in key forums - challenging constructively, highlighting risks and opportunities, and helping leaders see decisions through a customer lens.

  1. Business strategy & decision support

  • Synthesize evidence from multiple sources - including customer insight, analytics, CX, market intelligence, commercial performance and external trends - into clear strategic recommendations for the business.

  • Develop compelling "so what / now what" narratives, presentations and workshops that help leaders and teams move from evidence to decision, creating clarity and alignment around key priorities.

  • Support stakeholders in evaluating strategic options and trade-offs relating to growth, customer experience, proposition development, portfolio choices and go-to-market decisions.

  • Ensure major insight programmes and strategic initiatives result in tangible business action, helping teams translate customer understanding into priorities, plans and measurable outcomes.

  1. Learning agenda and insight activation

  • Work closely with stakeholders and Insight team colleagues to ensure projects are framed against the right strategic questions for your segment.

  • Define and maintain a prioritised learning roadmap for your business area, aligned to the biggest opportunities, risks and decisions.

  • Spot knowledge gaps and emerging questions and translate them into clear briefs and programmes of work.

  • Act as a connector across functions and disciplines - joining up signals across teams and sources into a unified view of customer needs and market dynamics.

  • Play a leading role in developing the quarterly State of Play (integrated customer narrative) in collaboration with Insight team colleagues.

Skills & experience

Essential experience

  • Significant experience in customer insight, strategy, consulting or a closely related field, ideally in consumer technology, subscription, financial services or adjacent categories.

  • Proven track record of partnering with senior stakeholders on major strategic or commercial decisions (e.g., portfolio strategy, brand positioning, proposition development, experience design, go-to-market).

  • Experience synthesising multiple data and insight sources (qual, quant, analytics, CX, market intel) into concise, decision-ready outputs.

  • Demonstrated impact in turning insight into action - influencing real changes in products, experiences, communications or commercial strategy.

Skills & capabilities

  • Strategic, structured thinker - able to frame problems, prioritise questions, and connect customer insight to business outcomes.

  • Strong storytelling and communication - comfortable simplifying complexity, building clear narratives and presenting confidently to senior audiences.

  • Commercially astute - understands how brands grow, how P&Ls work, and how customer behaviour shows up in performance metrics.

  • Collaborative and credible - able to work effectively across teams, building trust and alignment in a matrix environment.

  • Influential without authority - willing and able to challenge thinking, propose alternatives and guide teams towards more customer-centric choices.

Mindset

  • Customer-obsessed - motivated by building a truthful, nuanced view of our customers and using it to drive better decisions.

  • Insight-to-action oriented - focused on impact, not just analysis; always asking "so what?" and "now what?".

  • Low-ego, high ownership - comfortable operating autonomously, rolling up their sleeves, and taking responsibility for outcomes in their segment.

What's Next

Your CV will be reviewed together by the recruiter and hiring manager to assess the scope of your role, the impact you've delivered, and how your experience aligns with the position. If shortlisted, the recruiter will invite you to an initial Zoom conversation to discuss your background, what's compelling you to Gen, and walk you through the interview process.

Gen is an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs.

Benefits


At Gen Digital, we are committed to supporting our employees’ well-being and professional growth. Our comprehensive benefits package for UK team members includes:

  • Health & Wellbeing – Company-paid private medical insurance, dental and vision benefits, plus access to mental health and wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).

  • Financial Security – A Group Personal Pension Plan with auto-enrolment for eligible employees, together with the opportunity to purchase Gen stock through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off – available once statutory annual leave has been used, plus company holidays and a range of leave options to support personal and family needs.

  • Tuition Reimbursement – Up to £5,150 per calendar year for job-related accredited courses that support career development within Gen.

  • Wellness Reimbursement – Up to $450 per year to cover fitness-related expenses.

  • Sustainability Allowance – A $500 annual sustainable home improvement allowance.

title: (Junior) Integration Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at GLS/NXT
description_html:
We are looking for an Integration Manager to drive the successful rollout of innovative digital products across a growing range of markets and partners at GLS/NXT.

Your main responsibility as Integration Manager will be to lead and coordinate technical integrations between the GLS/NXT and the broader GLS corporate organization (and beyond), ensuring smooth adoption and strong stakeholder alignment.

You will work at the intersection of product, tech, and operations, ultimately aligning corporate requirements with the agile work environment at GLS/NXT. Your focus will be on reducing complexity in implementations, driving structured communication, and ensuring long-term product adoption both internally and externally.

This role is perfect for someone who is well-organized, process-driven and interested in breaking down complex technical tasks into digestible pieces.

Tasks

  • Manage integration projects: Drive international integration projects end-to-end by coordinating between GLS/NXT and internal or external stakeholders to ensure a smooth and well-structured onboarding process.
  • Ensure successful product adoption: Support customers beyond integration by helping them understand and realize the value of GLS/NXT products through user behavior analysis, feedback loops, and personal sparring
  • Bridge tech and business: Translate technical requirements into clear deliverables and timelines, ensuring efficient coordination between tech teams, ensuring that the right information reaches the right people at the right time
  • Improve integration processes: Identify gaps and pain points in the current setup and proactively drive improvements through documentation, tooling, and automation
  • Manage stakeholder relationships: Build strong, empathetic relationships with internal and external stakeholders and ensure GLS/NXT is well-represented within the corporate environment
  • Create visibility and impact: Report on integration progress and outcomes, highlighting key successes and learnings team-internal or to the leadership team

Requirements

  • ≥2 years of experience in integration, implementation, (technical) project management or customer success management in B2B
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with a structured approach to problem-solving
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and cultures
  • Fundamental understanding of technical concepts (API, system architecture or digital platform products
  • Business-level proficiency in English, both written and spoken
  • Ability to travel within the EU (10%)
  • Permission to work in Germany

Benefits

  • Dynamic workplace: A digital environment with international projects and space to learn and grow
  • Flexible work conditions: Hybrid working mode with a tailored remote policy
  • Focus on learning: A personal budget (1.000€) for learning and development initiatives
  • Physical space for ideas: A great office space in Berlin Mitte with top-tier equipment
  • Transparent and competitive compensation: A salary package that reflects your expertise and experience.
  • Active participation: A clear bonus system enabling participation in your and the team’s performance
  • Engaging team culture: Monthly team cooking, regular events and offsites
  • Vacation policy: 30 days of yearly holiday

Even if you do not meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply if you believe you are well-suited for the role and can contribute meaningfully to our team.

About GLS/NXT

GLS/NXT was founded with the mission to build the next generation of logistic experiences driven by technology - core, adjacent & beyond. More specifically, our sphere of interest is the Logistics and eCommerce sector. We are entrepreneurs and hence always start with the user's needs. We are located between Corporate and Startups and leverage the benefits from both (startup speed and corporate muscle). GLS/NXT inhabits different project teams, acting as startups with business responsibility and setting their own vision and mission. GLS/NXT is part of the GLS IT Services GmbH.

Commitment to Diversity

GLS/NXT is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Research Scientist
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at DeepHealth
description_html:
Job Summary

The Senior Research Scientist sits on DeepHealth's ML Capabilities team and advances research in machine learning for medical imaging, with a focus on foundation models in radiology AI. This role designs novel model architectures, develops experimental systems to test research hypotheses, and helps translate research into solutions that support clinical applications. The work draws on DeepHealth's large-scale imaging data and expert feedback loops and includes collaboration with research partners such as Imperial College London.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Define and drive the scientific roadmap for foundation models in medical imaging within the ML Capabilities programme.

  • Track and evaluate developments in machine learning and generative AI relevant to radiology and multimodal imaging.

  • Design and prototype novel model architectures for multimodal medical imaging data.

  • Develop experimental systems to validate research hypotheses and measure progress against scientific goals.

  • Establish and maintain benchmarking frameworks across downstream clinical and technical tasks.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to translate research advances into deployable solutions.

  • Lead scientific publications and conference contributions that communicate DeepHealth research results.

  • Engage with external research collaborators, including partners at Imperial College London.

  • Mentor researchers and contribute to research quality standards within the ML Capabilities team.

  • Document methods, experiments, and findings to support reproducibility, review, and knowledge transfer.

 

 PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above.  Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field (required).

  • Strong publication record at top machine learning venues (for example, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) (required).

  • Expertise in deep learning and generative models (required).

  • Experience designing and evaluating machine learning systems (required).

  • Preferred: Experience in medical imaging or healthcare AI.

  • Preferred: Familiarity with multimodal learning.

  • Preferred: Experience mentoring or leading research projects.

Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance. 

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

Working Environment

Hybrid/Remote.

title: Paid Social Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Numan
description_html:
About Numan 
 
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
 
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
 
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 
 
• Patients first.
• Learn fast.
• Own the quality.
• Succeed together.
• Care deeply.
 
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

The Role: 

We're looking for a Paid Social Manager to run Numan's Meta account hands-on, every day. Reporting into the Head of Growth, you'll work closely with our Senior Paid Social Lead and turn their strategy into live activity: account structure changes, ad uploads, optimisation and feed management in Smartly.

You'll also be part of a growing creative engine. We ship hundreds of new assets a month, and your analysis of what's working, and why, goes straight into the briefs that produce our next winning ads.

You're fast in Meta. You can build out an account, get a big batch of ads live cleanly and make considered optimisation calls without a step-by-step brief. You have opinions on creative, such as why a hook worked or why a UGC ad beat a hi-fi one, and you back them with data. You also reach for AI and tooling to take the repetitive work out of the day.

In return you get close coaching from a specialist who lives in Meta, and an expert growth team, with room to grow into a bigger paid social and growth remit.


What you'll do:
  • Build and launch campaigns quickly and accurately in Meta Ads Manager, from new account builds to large ad uploads

  • Implement the Senior Paid Social Lead's strategy, including account structure changes as the platform and our approach evolve

  • Optimise daily across budgets, bidding, audiences and placements, with a clear reason behind every change

  • Keep the account healthy: watch performance and platform diagnostics, catch issues early and dig into the cause

  • Handle ad policy, disapprovals and account restrictions within healthcare compliance guardrails

  • Manage feeds in Smartly and help build out template-led production, for example Hook × Body × CTA for video

  • Keep bulk uploads, naming conventions and QA tight so hundreds of ads can go live without errors

  • Find ways AI and automation can speed up launches, QA and reporting

  • Analyse creative performance across formats (Reels, Stories, Feed), asset types (video and static) and styles (UGC and hi-fi)

  • Use Motion and our BI tools to find the hooks, angles and messages that win

  • Turn what you find into insights and hypotheses the creative team can brief from, then see those ideas through to live tests

  • Run the creative testing programme day to day and keep a clear record of what wins and why

  • Plan and run landing page tests with the Growth team, and read the results through to CAC and CM2

  • Report on performance against CAC, LTV and payback as well as platform metrics, and explain what's driving change

  • Support signal quality work with the data team, including CAPI, event setup and value-based optimisation

  • Work with brand, creative, CRO and data as part of one growth team


    • What we're looking for:
  • 3–5 years in paid social, most of it hands-on in Meta Ads Manager at meaningful spend
  • Speed and accuracy in Meta: you can build an account from scratch, restructure one and push large ad uploads live cleanly
  • A sharp eye for creative performance, with a point of view on video vs static and UGC vs hi-fi that you can back with data
  • Experience turning creative analysis into insights a creative team can act on
  • Hands-on experience running landing page or on-site tests
  • Sound analytical habits: you can say what changed, why it changed and what you'd do next
  • An AI-first instinct for tools and automation that remove friction from the day
  • A real appetite to learn from an expert, ask good questions and take on more as you grow
  • High execution energy and ownership; you get things live without waiting for the perfect brief

title: Grafikdesigner – Social Ads / Performance Creatives (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ADMKRS GmbH
description_html:
Deine Mission

Bevor du weiterliest: Diese Stelle ist bewusst nicht für alle geschrieben. Bei uns hast du sehr viel Freiheit. Wir kontrollieren nicht, wann du wie arbeitest, sondern was am Ende rauskommt. Diese Freiheit bekommst du aber nur mit Verantwortung: für deine Projekte, für deine Deadlines und für die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden.

Teamwork steht bei uns an erster Stelle. Wir helfen uns gegenseitig, springen füreinander ein und liefern gemeinsam richtig geile Arbeit ab. Das funktioniert nur, wenn alle mitziehen. Wer das nicht tut, mit dem trennen wir uns konsequent, spätestens in der Probezeit. Das ist nicht böse gemeint, wir schulden es dem Rest des Teams.

Wenn du einen gemütlichen Job suchst, spar dir und uns die Zeit. Bewirb dich nur, wenn du glaubst, dass du unser Team wirklich ergänzt, und die Ambitionen mitbringst, zu den Besten zu gehören. Wir sind ein Office-First-Team im Herzen Münchens und setzen auf enge Zusammenarbeit, starke Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Lieferqualität ohne Kompromisse. Lies die Ausschreibung bitte bis zum Ende, das ist schon Teil der Bewerbung.

Du denkst in Hooks, nicht nur in Moodboards. Du weißt, dass eine Static Ad in unter zwei Sekunden entscheidet, ob jemand stoppt oder weiterscrollt, und genau dafür gestaltest du. In unserem Grafik-Team entwickelst du Statics, Carousels und ganze Ad-Serien für E-Commerce und DTC Brands auf Meta, TikTok und Google. Die sollen nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern messbar verkaufen. Du arbeitest eng mit Creative Strategy und dem Performance-Team zusammen, siehst die Zahlen deiner Creatives und nutzt sie, um das nächste Creative noch besser zu machen.

Konkret

  • Du gestaltest Static Ads, Carousels und Ad-Varianten für Meta (Feed, Story, Reels), TikTok und Google auf Basis unserer Creative Briefings.
  • Du übersetzt Hooks, Angles und Offers in Layouts, die im Feed sofort funktionieren: klare Hierarchie, auf dem Handy lesbar, Produkt im Fokus.
  • Du baust schnell und sauber Iterationen von Winner-Ads: neue Hooks, Formate, Visuals, Farbwelten.
  • Du arbeitest innerhalb der Brand Guidelines und weißt, wann du sie im Sinne der Performance dehnen kannst.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Motion und Video zusammen und lieferst Dateien, die direkt animiert werden können.
  • Du setzt KI-Tools (z. B. Firefly, Generative Fill, Midjourney) gezielt für Compositing, Freisteller und Szenen ein, ohne dass das Ergebnis nach KI aussieht.
  • Du organisierst deine Projekte selbstständig und lieferst zuverlässig pünktlich.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Grafikdesigner, davon nachweislich mit Social Ads oder Performance Creatives (Agentur oder In-house bei einer E-Commerce Brand).
  • Sicher in Photoshop, Illustrator und Figma.
  • Ein starkes Portfolio mit echten, live geschalteten Ads. Reine Branding-, Print- oder Uni-Projekte reichen für diese Rolle nicht.
  • Sehr gutes Gespür für Typografie, Layout, Farbe und Bildbearbeitung (Retusche, Compositing, Freisteller).
  • Du kennst die Ad-Formate (1:1, 4:5, 9:16) und Safe Zones und weißt, wie ein Static im Feed wirken muss.
  • Du weißt, was CTR, Hook Rate und ROAS bedeuten, und willst verstehen, warum ein Creative gewinnt.
  • Du arbeitest schnell und bleibst trotzdem pixelgenau, auch bei der 20. Variante.
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (in Wort und Schrift).
  • Lebensmittelpunkt München (unverzichtbar). Wir setzen auf Office-First.

Diese Rolle ist NICHT für dich, wenn:

description_html:
KEY ACCOUNT DIRECTOR, NEW BUSINESS: ENTERPRISE BRAND PARTNERSHIPS (German-speaking)
Berlin, Germany · Hybrid · Full-time

ABOUT US
At The Global Talent Co., we connect exceptional commercial talent with high-growth European businesses. We offer competitive packages, stable employment, and access to a global community of 25,000+ professionals.

ABOUT THE COMPANY
Since 2014, this Berlin-headquartered company has quietly become Europe's leading partner for premium custom signage. It is trusted by some of the most recognised names in retail, luxury, automotive, hospitality, and tech, and its client list reads like a who's who of European brand marketing.

They don't need to prove the product works. Brands already love it. What they're building now is a commercial function to match.

THE ROLE
This role is built for a hunter. You've spent years selling complex, physical brand solutions such as retail environments, POS and visual merchandising, shop fitting, trade fair builds, brand experiences, or large-format production.

You know what it takes to move a physical project from first brief to signed contract, and you know how to hold your ground with procurement along the way.

You're not coming in to manage an existing book. You're coming in to open doors. Once you bring a client in, an expert internal team handles all delivery, so your focus stays on pipeline and new accounts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Proactively identify and win new enterprise brand accounts, from first outreach through to signed deal

  • Build and own relationships with Heads of Brand, Retail Marketing, Visual Merchandising, and senior marketing leaders across Europe

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes involving marketing, retail operations, and procurement

  • Scope complex physical projects with clients and brief internal experts sharply from day one

  • Grow accounts over time through upsell, repeat orders, and multi-location rollouts

  • Represent the company at relevant trade fairs and industry events, such as EuroShop, chosen selectively and worked strategically

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • New business, key account, or sales experience at one of the following:

    • Brand experience, retail, or shopper marketing agencies

    • POS and visual merchandising agencies or suppliers

    • Shop building or trade fair construction companies

    • Event agencies with retail or gastro clients

    • Large-format printing and production companies

  • A track record of selling complex physical builds or projects to enterprise brands

  • Hands-on experience with procurement: tenders, RFPs, pricing negotiations, and framework agreements

  • A genuine hunter mentality. You're comfortable building pipeline from scratch and getting in front of the right people

  • Commercially structured: you manage a pipeline with discipline and keep complex deals moving

  • Native-level German essential; professional English required

WHAT'S ON OFFER

  • Genuine autonomy: your desk, your relationships, your outcomes

  • A Berlin-based hybrid role with a founder-led team that has been building since 2014

  • The chance to sell a product that major European brands genuinely love, with zero delivery responsibility once you close

Compensation: €60K – €90K

  • • Base Salary €60K – €90K

title: Business Development Manager, DACH
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Siteminder
description_html:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

What we do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

As a Business Development Manager you will be a key driver of new business growth across the DACH region, engaging and advising customers across various segments from small independent hotels and boutique properties to large hotel groups and travel tech partners. You will be joining and representing the leading AI technology platform redefining guest acquisition and hotel revenue management. You will be relied on not just to close new business but to strategically influence pipeline growth, long-term partnerships and commercial excellence.

We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach, guide and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.

We know that an attractive compensation package is a key motivator in sales. SiteMinder offers you not only this, but also a working environment that represents ambition, collaboration, self-development and customer-centricity. If you identify with our core values (We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple) and you are a sales hunter at heart and able to work at a fast pace, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Do...

  • Lead full-cycle sales and business development: identify, engage and convert new prospects into customers.

  • Strategic territory and pipeline growth: define and execute strategic qualification routines, build segmented pipelines from your territory, and prioritise opportunities that deliver high value.

  • Consistently achieving sales KPIs and targets: work towards daily, weekly and monthly targets. Accountability will be important to help you succeed.

  • Trusted advisor engagement: conduct insightful discovery and product presentations, consulting on clients’ business and commercial goals, and present proposals to clients in a professional and confident manner. Negotiate contracts as required, maintaining a balance between optimal service and value for the client and SiteMinder's profit margins.

  • CRM ownership & intelligence: maintain disciplined CRM practices to ensure pipeline, forecasts, reporting, and customer insights are accurate and actionable.

  • Collaborate across functions: partner with Onboarding, Marketing, Product and Customer Success teams to refine market messaging, feedback loops, and go-to-market strategies that will improve our competitiveness.

  • Representing the company: work with local industry groups and travel associations to promote SiteMinder’s products and brand. Attend key functions and events, support webinars and other tactical initiatives to raise brand awareness, requiring occasional travel to client locations to attend meetings with relevant managers.

What You Have...

  • Sales & business development experience: extensive experience closing deals with full-cycle responsibility, ideally across SaaS, hospitality technology, hotel operations, revenue management, or related commercial services.

  • Industry fluency: solid understanding of the hospitality value chain (hotel management, revenue strategy, guest acquisition…).

  • Consultative and outcome-focused sales skills: demonstrated ability to diagnose business needs, tailor solutions and influence decision-making with impact.

  • Remote-ready communication & autonomy: excellent verbal and written communicator, strong listener, adept at building rapport and driving processes without day-to-day supervision.

  • Resilience & growth mindset: high level of self-motivation, curiosity to learn continuously and openness to feedback and coaching.

  • Analytical and tech-savvy: strong proficiency with CRM and sales tools.

  • Fluent in German (min. C2) and professional proficiency in English.

  • Please send us your CV in English!

Our Perks & Benefits…

  • Remote setup

  • Equity packages for you to share in SiteMinder's growth and successes

  • Investment in your personal growth

  • Uncapped commission that rewards overachievement

  • Excellence-driven, collaborative culture

  • Well-being initiatives

  • Referral bonus for bringing in new talent

  • Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy

  • Paid birthday, study and volunteering days off every year

  • Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any adjustments you may need during the interview process. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

title: Workplace and People Operations Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Telli
description_html:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission
As Workplace & People Operations Manager at telli, you own the environment our team does its best work in. You're responsible for keeping our Berlin office running smoothly day to day: workplace processes, people ops, internal events, and the culture initiatives that make telli feel like telli.

what you'll do:

  • run our Berlin office: supplies, equipment, and making sure we stay productive and well-organized

  • drive culture initiatives that keep the team connected as we grow

  • own the employee lifecycle, from onboarding (so new joiners have desk, hardware, and access ready before they walk in) to offboarding

  • build automations around workplace and people ops (ordering, inventory, requests) with AI and no-code tools

  • jump in wherever help is needed, because no two weeks look the same

what makes you a great fit:

  • you have a few years of experience in workplace, office, or people operations, ideally at a startup

  • you're hands-on and happy to do the unglamorous work that makes everything else possible

  • you're organized, reliable, and notice the details others miss

  • you build processes that scale instead of solving the same problem twice

  • you're curious about tools and automation and pick up new things fast

  • you take ownership and don't wait for detailed instructions

  • you communicate well in both English and German

  • you're a host at heart and love creating great experiences for others

you may not be a great fit if:

  • you only want to do high-level "strategic" work

  • juggling multiple things at once stresses you out

  • you want to work fully remote, since this role lives in the office

  • you'd rather watch than roll up your sleeves

title: Implementation Manager DACH
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mollie
description_html:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

 

Your impact

As Implementation Manager, you'll own the post-sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, guiding merchants from handover through testing to go live. You'll run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, set go live dates, keep progress on track, and coordinate testing and feedback along the way. You'll work closely with colleagues across sales, product and engineering, as well as with merchants directly, keeping everyone aligned as deals move toward launch.

This function is newly formed, so you'll have real influence over how the role and its processes take shape, bringing in your own experience rather than following a fixed playbook. The role is also more technical than it might first appear: you'll get close to the real world edge cases and issues that surface once a solution meets implementation reality, giving you hands on technical exposure without needing a payments or engineering background going in.

Your work protects revenue by keeping live dates on track, and it supports how Mollie scales delivery more broadly, building a structured, dedicated integration phase for its biggest deals. You'll report to Jan-Jaap van Helden.

 

What you'll ship

  • Own the post sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, from handover through testing to go live

  • Run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, setting go live dates and keeping progress on track

  • Organise and track testing, raising issues and feedback as they surface

  • Coordinate across sales, product and engineering colleagues, as well as with merchants directly, to keep everyone aligned

  • Keep agreed go live dates on track, since delays mean missed revenue

  • Maintain documentation and playbooks that make delivery predictable and scalable

     

What you'll bring

  • Up to 3 years of experience in ecommerce or payments, in a similar role

  • Fluent in German and English, since this role supports the German market and works directly with local merchants

  • Strong organisational and structuring skills, with solid project management ability

  • Genuine technical interest and the ability to understand technical concepts such as APIs, since this role gets close to the edge cases that surface once a solution meets reality

  • An ownership mindset, taking charge of the implementation process rather than reacting to it, while staying flexible within agreed roles and processes

  • Honest, open communication style with a genuine, trustworthy manner, including a strong track record collaborating with pre-sales teams and handling conflict at handover

  • Payments or ecommerce experience, or familiarity with the ecosystem, is a strong plus though not required

 

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

 

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

description_html:
Wer wir sind:
Wir entwickeln die Intelligenz, die es Robotern ermöglicht, die reale Welt wahrzunehmen, zu verstehen und in ihr zu handeln – über das Labor hinaus und hinein in den industriellen Alltag, etwa in Lagerhallen und Fabriken. Unsere Technologie schließt die Automatisierungslücken, an denen klassische Systeme scheitern. Überblick:

Qualifikationen:

description_html:
Wer wir sind

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Embodied AI, das die menschliche Arbeitswelt revolutioniert. Mit modernster Robotik und fortschrittlicher künstlicher Intelligenz entwickeln wir transformative Technologien, die neu definieren, wie Arbeit über verschiedenste Branchen hinweg erledigt wird — und ermöglichen es Unternehmen, Abläufe zu optimieren, die Produktivität zu steigern und neue Möglichkeiten zu erschließen.

Überblick

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Elektriker, der die elektrische Verkabelung und Steuerungssysteme unserer autonomen Robotersysteme installiert, verkabelt und in Stand hält. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng mit unserem Mechanical- und Hardware-Team zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle elektrischen Komponenten zuverlässig funktionieren und nahtlos in die Gesamtsysteme integriert sind.

Deine Aufgaben

Elektrokonstruktion und Planung:

  • Elektrokonstruktion gemäß geltenden Richtlinien und Normen.

  • Erstellung von Schaltplänen für unsere Robotersysteme.

Installation und Verkabelung:

  • Verkabelung und Installation elektrischer Komponenten und Steuerungssysteme in unseren Robotersystemen.

  • Montage von Schaltschränken, Steckverbindern und Sensorik nach technischen Zeichnungen und Schaltplänen.

  • Verlegung und Anschluss von Kabeln unter Einhaltung geltender Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards.

Test, Wartung und Fehlerbehebung:

  • Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme elektrischer Systeme vor Auslieferung und Installation beim Kunden.

  • Diagnose und Behebung elektrischer Störungen während der Entwicklung, der Fertigung und im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Durchführung regelmäßiger Wartungs- und Sicherheitsprüfungen an bestehenden Systemen.

Zusammenarbeit:

  • Enge Abstimmung mit den Mechanical- und Software-Teams zur Integration elektronischer Komponenten in die physische Struktur der Roboter.

  • Unterstützung bei Vor-Ort-Installationen und Inbetriebnahmen beim Kunden.

  • Reisebereitschaft ~50%

Qualifikationen & Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektriker, Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Mechatroniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Schaltplänen sowie Kenntnisse in Verkabelung, Verdrahtung und Anschlusstechnik.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten (z. B. Multimeter, Oszilloskop).

  • Kenntnisse relevanter elektrischer Sicherheitsnormen und -vorschriften.

  • Erfahrung in der Robotik, Automatisierungstechnik oder im Maschinenbau von Vorteil.

  • Selbstständige, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie Teamfähigkeit.

Was wir bieten:

  • Wellpass (Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft)

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten von zu Hause aus bei Bedarf

  • Ein motiviertes Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur

  • Attraktive Vergütung und hervorragende Karrieremöglichkeiten

title: Chief of Staff to the Co-CEO - m/f/d
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Langdock
description_html:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

 

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.


About the Role

Judith Dada is Co-CEO of Langdock alongside Lennard. She is also Senior Partner at Visionaries Club, serves on the board of Personio, co-founded Relativity Collective, a programme for Europe’s student founders, and writes about AI, creativity, Europe and human flourishing as Dadalogue. She co-authored Europa 2031. What connects all of it is a conviction that technological progress, done well, is how we build a better Europe and a better world.

As Chief of Staff, you will be Judith’s right hand across everything she does. Your job is to extend her reach and impact across Langdock, Europe’s AI ecosystem and beyond. You will structure and execute across a wide surface area, and create the conditions in which Judith does her best work. You will work with her every day, so expect the steepest learning curve of your career.

Langdock’s product is expanding fast in two directions: across the work people do, with chat, agents, meetings, code and apps; and down the stack into our own compute and inference. You will help Judith stay close to the most important work across this growing product surface and the company.

What You Will Do

Run meticulous project management. You will hold the threads across dozens of topics and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You work half a step ahead, spot bottlenecks before they happen and follow through. You act as an honest broker: synthesising and pressure-testing plans to bring them to their full potential.

Augment Judith’s execution at Langdock. You will keep Judith close to the most important work across a fast-growing product surface. You will prepare her for key decisions, make sure things happen afterwards and support strategic workstreams.

Produce Judith’s ideas. You will structure and challenge Judith’s thinking to draw out the idea worth making, then shape it into a keynote, essay, video, panel, interview or key event. You will help turn customer insights and research into thought leadership that shapes how European leaders think about AI. AI is already an exceptionally capable research assistant; your value lies in depth, taste and operational structure. You do not ghostwrite. You sharpen the thinking and run the flow from first idea to finished piece.

Scale executive engagement. Together with Marketing, you will design exceptional rooms and experiences that bring Europe’s key AI decision-makers together. You will work with our go-to-market teams so Judith’s external work serves the needs of a customer base that is growing quickly.

Extend Judith’s reach into policy and the European AI ecosystem. You will prepare and follow through on policy work and ecosystem initiatives, helping Judith contribute to the conversations shaping AI in Europe.

What Makes This Different

You will work at the forefront of one of the most consequential technological shifts in history. Langdock has grown to around $50M ARR and more than 13,000 customers while remaining profitable and independent of outside investment. You will join at a moment when our product is expanding quickly and Europe needs AI companies built from Europe for the world.

Judith is Co-CEO of Langdock, Senior Partner at Visionaries Club and active across the European AI ecosystem. This role gives you a front-row seat across that breadth of work, with direct responsibility for helping turn ideas and decisions into action.

This is a tour of duty. We ask for a commitment of at least two years, with the explicit prospect of shaping a longer-term role together once we know where you shine. The scope is broad, the feedback loops are short and the learning curve is steep.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You have a few years of experience in consulting, investing or a startup that grew quickly. You know how to structure chaos and are still incredibly hungry to learn.

  • You have a deep fascination with technology and AI, and a real belief that technological progress can build a better world.

  • You have impeccable taste. You know what good looks like in a sentence, a slide, an event and an argument, and you can act with confidence in Judith’s stead.

  • You have range and depth. You can switch context many times a day and still go deep when it counts.

  • You write clearly and speak well in the room, in both German and English.

  • You bring calm and good judgement. You know what matters and what can wait, read people well, and hold them accountable with kindness.

  • You see problems and fix them without being asked, and stay persistent until they are done.

  • You are discreet and trustworthy, because you will see everything.

  • You have an exceptional work ethic and are comfortable with a highly demanding role that includes some travel.

The Environment

You will sit with Judith in our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all 65 of us work together in person. Judith has a dedicated Executive Assistant for calendar, travel and admin. You will work closely with them and with Lennard’s Chief of Staff on day-to-day matters.

Breakfast, lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense.


Next steps

We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks. If this sounds like your kind of work, we would love to hear from you.

title: Legal Counsel - m/f/d
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Langdock
description_html:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

At Langdock, legal is part of the product. Some of Europe's largest and most regulated companies use Langdock for work that involves their most sensitive documents and data. Before a single employee logs in, their legal, data protection and security teams need to be convinced. What we promise about data, models and control becomes real in our contracts, our DPA and the way we answer their questions.

This is where you come in. As Legal Counsel, you own your matters end to end: enterprise contracts, data protection, the regulation that applies to an AI company, compliance and employment law for a growing team. Often you will be the person who gets a deal signed.

In our day-to-day work, we want to show what AI can do for legal work and rethink how work itself gets done with it. We treat every business function as an applied AI discipline. You will design new AI powered workflows, experiment with internal automations, and continuously refine how legal operates using our state-of-the-art products.

What You Will Do

Work directly with customers. Negotiate customer agreements from first call to signature, including DPAs, security and AI terms, DORA addenda for financial services.

Solve open questions. Translate new regulations like the AI Act, DORA, NIS2, the Data Act and the sector rules our customers work under into concrete requirements for our product.

Build the future cloud. Shape the contracts behind our data center and new cloud services, from power and hardware to the terms our customers sign.

Keep the company running. Advise internally on employment law, do corporate housekeeping, own our data protection program, and support in keeping our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance current.

Use Langdock constantly. Build and maintain the agents, playbooks and evals behind our self-serve legal tools. As one of Langdock's most demanding users, your feedback goes straight to Product.

Work with kind individuals. We are a small team of highly ambitious people with low egos. We want to have fun and enjoy working together.

What Makes This Different

You are working at the forefront of potentially the biggest technological shift in history. Working at Langdock prepares you for the future of work.

We went from €1M to €50M+ ARR and becoming profitable. No aggressive sales tactics. No unsustainable burn.

You will join early enough to shape how things work, but late enough that we have traction, customers, and a product people love. The hard part is not convincing people AI matters. It is helping them adopt it well. That is a genuinely interesting problem.

You will also learn fast. Our team is small, the scope is large, and the feedback loops are short. People who joined a year ago are now running critical functions. If you are good, you will grow.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You are a qualified lawyer with at least two years of experience in-house at a technology company or advising one. You have negotiated SaaS agreements and DPAs with enterprise counterparties.

  • You have built something – an agent, a workflow, a clause library, a script, a template system. You can tell us what changed because of it.

  • You want to understand the technology behind the products you advise on, not just the contracts around them. You are technical enough to know how SaaS products are built: databases, APIs, integrations, basic architecture.

  • You can write and reason clearly and can tell which risks should stop a deal or feature.

  • You are fluent in German and English. German-law employment and contract work makes German necessary; the team and most customer documents are English.

  • You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

The Environment

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

We offer lunch & dinner in the office. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks. The process includes a case study based on the kind of questions we handle day to day. We care more about how deep you go and how quickly you get there than about which topics you have covered before.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

Compensation: €80K – €120K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Product Engineering
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Secfix
description_html:
Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.

I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.

Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.

That means a strong engineering manager who can still ship. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works.

You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.

— Grigory


Why Secfix exists

Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.

Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.

We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.

This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.


What you'll actually do in the first 3 months

This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:

Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. You don't need to be the fastest engineer in the room, but the team needs to see that you can build at the level you'll ask of them and can ask the right questions.

Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start regular 1:1s with each engineer, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI.

Month 3: Own hiring. Take over engineering interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.


What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months?

After the first quarter, the job is management and the technical decisions. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — most of that hiring is yours to run.

You won't ship weekly, but you'll build something with the team now and then, because that's how you know the playbook still gets things out the door. Our CS and Sales leaders work the same way — they still own a small slice of the IC work, so they have skin in the game.

Here's what you'll be close to in the next months:

  • Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it.

  • Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20.

  • Team and hiring. Team structure, growth conversations, the hiring process, and eventually the next manager.

  • AI in the craft — and in the management. Engineers already work with an established set of encoded skills and rules — there's a whole playbook; you keep pushing that. Same for your own work: hiring, 1:1s, the recurring stuff.

What success looks like

At 6 months: The hiring process runs without me, and we've added 2 engineers through it. Sales, CS, and product all feel the difference in how fast we ship — and in quality.

At 12 months: The team is around 12-16, the zero-bug policy is still holding at that size, and I'm not in the engineering critical path anymore. You've found and/or coached the EM Nr. 2 to support growth.


How we work

We've written in depth about our engineering culture. Here's the short version — read the full articles linked below if you want the real picture.

  • Focus is sacred. Engineers are in fewer than 2 hours of meetings per week. We write before we meet. We use Loom for async walkthroughs, Notion for specs, Gather for pairing, and Slack only for what's urgent or lightweight. We don't do status theatre. We wrote about our thoughtful communication and our remote culture; give it a read.

    To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over a year:

  • Small, temporary teams. A designer and two engineers. A backend engineer and a CS person. The group forms around the problem, ships, and dissolves. No standing squads, no permanent team structures — at least not yet. The people closest to the problem usually shape the solution.

  • AI is already part of the craft. We use Claude for product design exploration and spec drafting. Engineers work in Cursor with encoded skills and rules that live in the codebase — component patterns, folder structure, architecture choices, and the path from Figma to Angular code. AI checks code against architecture rules before human review. We have a dedicated design QA skill that compares Figma against coded output. Quality as identity, in compliance, being correct isn't a nice-to-have; it's the entire value proposition. We care about edge cases, data integrity, and getting the details right.   • We build what customers need, not what they ask for. Customer feedback is signal, not instructions. Best products are built by people with great taste who treat feedback as signals, not KPIs. We stay close to customers — CS check-ins, support tickets, Mixpanel events, onboarding calls — but none of these sources makes the decision for us.

  • You communicate proactively in writing. In a remote team, written communication is how decisions get made and context gets shared. But you're not scared of jumping into a pair programming session either.


What we're looking for

title: Senior Product Designer
