title: Business Data Analyst Finance & Requirements Management (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aer Group
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben:

Du verstehst Geschäftsprozesse, denkst analytisch und kannst komplexe Anforderungen verständlich strukturieren? Du bewegst Dich sicher zwischen Fachbereichen und technischen Teams und hast Freude daran, aus Daten und Anforderungen tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln? Dann suchen wir genau Dich als Business Data Analyst Finance & Requirements Management (m/w/d) in Teilzeit mit 30 Stunden pro Woche. In dieser Rolle bildest Du die Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Finance und technischen Teams und sorgst dafür, dass fachliche Anforderungen in erfolgreiche datenbasierte Lösungen übersetzt werden.

 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entgegennehmen, Strukturieren und fachliches Bewerten von Anforderungen aus Business, Finance, Controlling und angrenzenden Fachbereichen
  • Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen, Datenflüssen und fachlichen Use Cases mit Fokus auf buchhaltungsrelevante Vorgänge, Leistungsabrechnungen, Provisionsweitergaben und daraus resultierende Reporting-Anforderungen
  • Prüfung von Daten auf fachliche Plausibilität, Vollständigkeit, Konsistenz und Eignung für den jeweiligen Anwendungsfall
  • Erarbeitung und Dokumentation fachlicher Anforderungen sowie deren Übersetzung in umsetzbare technische Anforderungen
  • Erstellung von Fachkonzepten, Spezifikationen, Datenlogiken, Mapping-Dokumentationen, Akzeptanzkriterien und Testfällen
  • Abstimmung von Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Lösungsansätzen zwischen Fachbereichen und technischen Teams
  • Unterstützung bei der Qualitätssicherung sowie fachliche Validierung von umgesetzten Lösungen und Reports
  • Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen, Anforderungen und Datenstrukturen


Dein Profil:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Finance/Controlling, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Datenanalyse oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse kaufmännischer, finanzieller oder abrechnungsbezogener Daten
  • Erfahrung im Bereich Business Analysis, Requirements Engineering oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Business- und Finanzprozessen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Abrechnung, Reporting, Provisionen, Controlling oder Finanzwesen
  • Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen strukturiert aufzunehmen, kritisch zu hinterfragen, zu priorisieren und in klare Umsetzungsanforderungen zu überführen
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Datenstrukturen, Datenqualität und fachliche Datenmodellierung
  • Erfahrungen mit BI- und Reporting-Lösungen sowie Kenntnisse in SQL, Python oder vergleichbaren Skript- bzw. Programmiersprachen sind von Vorteil
  • Kommunikationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zusammenzubringen
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

 


Warum wir:

  • Work-Life-Balance ist uns wichtig. Wir bieten deshalb eine flexible Home-Office-Regelung in individueller Absprache mit deinem Team Lead. Bis zu 30 Tage Workation pro Jahr sind bei uns ebenfalls möglich.
  • Bei uns gibt es nicht nur den üblichen Obstkorb sondern von Montag bis Freitag ein kostenloses, frisch gekochtes Mittagessen (Bio und regional) in unserer eigenen Kantine am Standort Berlin. Alle Kollegen an den anderen Standorten bekommen alternativ Pluxee Gutscheine.
  • Wir arbeiten in einem zentral gelegenem Loft-Office in Berlin Kreuzberg mit viel Platz zum gemeinsamen Austausch und Netzwerken.
  • Wir zahlen Dir monatlich einen ÖPNV-Zuschuss von 50 Euro.
  • Wir bieten einen Zuschuss zur Altersvorsorge.
  • Dein Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen: Bei uns kommt wöchentlich ein Masseur (Massagen inkl. Zuschuss vom Arbeitgeber) und wir veranstalten viele gemeinsame Team- und Firmenevents, vom Bowling übers Sommerfest bis zu selbst organisierten Kurzreisen.
  • Bei uns bekommst du branchenübliche Rabatte für dein Wochenende oder deinen Familienurlaub (z. B. günstige Flüge, Zugtickets, Hotelübernachtungen oder sogar ganze Urlaubspakete).
  • Unser Sustainability-Team freut sich auf deine Ideen für mehr Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz im Unternehmen.

title: Working Student | Accounting & Finance (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at TWAICE
description_html:
About the role

As renewable energy reshapes the global power system, batteries are taking center stage. Making them safe, reliable, and bankable at scale is a defining challenge of the energy transition. At TWAICE, our software turns battery data into insights - so decisions are made with confidence, not guesswo​​​​rk.

We're accelerating the transition into a new energy era and we're looking for those who want to move fast with us.

As a Working Student in our Finance Team, you’ll be involved in day-to-day operations, take on real ownership, and see firsthand how decisions shape the company. You won’t just observe; you'll play an active role in keeping the business running and growing.

This position has the potential to become a permanent role upon graduation.

Working hours and days are flexible (particularly around exams). You should be available for at least 15 hours per week and be able to come into our central Munich HQ once per week - though you're welcome to come in daily if you'd like.


Your daily business will involve

  • Take the lead on parts of Accounts Payable through Spendesk for our German and US entities - checking invoices for correctness under HGB/US-GAAP, applying the correct accounts and cost centers, and preparing payments for approvals.
  • Assist with monthly closing activities by coordinating input from internal stakeholders and tax advisors - ensuring expenses are accurately recorded, supporting documentation and receipts are complete, and all required entries are properly booked and reconciled.
  • Support monthly financial reporting, including cost and budget tracking.
  • Own the documentation of how our finance processes work. Prepare guides that our auditors, tax advisors and your colleagues will rely on.
BONUS TOPICS:
  • Help manage and optimize expense management & budgets using Spendesk
  • Support Accounts Receivable, including order processing, invoicing, and revenue recognition
  • Contribute to process optimization and tool improvements within Finance


Your profile

  • Enrolled student in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a comparable field 
  • Hands-on mindset: you spot what needs to be done, take ownership of it, and deliver reliable results 
  • Comfortable working with financial data & spreadsheets
  • Strong communication skills: you convey information clearly and in the right level of detail for internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong interest in practical accounting work and basic knowledge of accounting principles (HGB, US-GAAP)
  • Interest in tax, cost, and budget reporting
  • Fluent in English (must-have) and German (B2 level) 
  • First exposure to DATEV, QuickBooks, or Spendesk is a plus
Please consider that the requirements are not listed in order of importance, and we know it is nearly impossible to tick every box. If you can see yourself making a valuable contribution at TWAICE, we’d be delighted to receive your application regardless.


What we offer

  • Hands-on experience in Accounting & Finance at a global scale-up
  • Close collaboration with experienced finance professionals
  • High responsibility from day one and a steep learning curve
  • Central Munich office, hybrid setup, and flexible working hours
  • €16 (Bachelor's) to €18 (Master's) per hour
  • Potential for a permanent role after graduation


Follow along

See what TWAICE is up to https://www.linkedin.com/company/twaice/

description_html:
About the role

As renewable energy reshapes the global power system, batteries are taking center stage. Making them safe, reliable, and bankable at scale is a defining challenge of the energy transition. At TWAICE, our software turns battery data into insights - so decisions are made with confidence, not guesswork.

We're accelerating the transition into a new energy era and we're looking for those who want to move fast with us.

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will be working in our product teams to create customer value at a high pace. This includes taking part in the full product development cycle, from understanding user problems and shaping solutions to building and iterating on them. You will work in a team with backgrounds in Software and Battery Engineering – creating solutions to get our projects from definition to customer value quickly while making sure we deliver robust, scalable, and extensible software products.
Together, we will push our battery analytics to the next level.


Your daily business will involve

  • Contribute to and help shape the feature set of our SaaS product in incremental and result-oriented steps
  • Implement new software components across the stack, from our backend services to our API layer and frontend serving customers across industries
  • Take ownership of features and parts of the product – from refinement through implementation to maintenance – with guidance from the senior engineers in your team
  • Continuously ship code to production through our CI/CD process and apply monitoring and observability best practices to make sure everything runs smoothly
  • Grow your craft with us: pair with experienced engineers, contribute to code reviews and take part in regular cross-team knowledge sharing


Your profile

  • Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience
  • Around 1–4 years of professional experience building and running software in production
  • Comfortable across the stack – for example TypeScript/Python on the backend and Angular, React, or a comparable framework on the frontend
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, well-tested code
  • Collaborative working style – code reviews, knowledge sharing, open feedback
  • Curiosity about battery technology and energy storage, even without prior exposure
Good to have
  • Experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform, and building RESTful APIs
  • Exposure to timeseries data or data visualization tools

title: Product Owner (m/w/d) - Customer Domain
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at doctari GmbH
description_html:
Über uns

Seit 2008 arbeiten wir mit unseren vier Marken doctari, lichtfeld, Planerio und arztpool an unserer Vision, medizinisches Personal dorthin zu bringen, wo es am dringendsten benötigt wird.

doctari pro ist unsere B2B-Buchungsplattform für Personalverantwortliche in Krankenhäusern und Gesundheitseinrichtungen und die zentrale Schnittstelle zur Demand-Seite unseres Marktplatzes. Über doctari pro können Ärztinnen und Ärzte unkompliziert gefunden, angefragt und gebucht werden: in Arbeitnehmerüberlassung oder befristeter Anstellung. Als Gegenstück zur doctari App auf der Kandidatenseite ist doctari pro ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres zweiseitigen Marktplatzes.


Deine neue Rolle

Als Product Owner (m/w/d) im Customer Domain Team übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen der wichtigsten Wachstumshebel unseres Unternehmens. Gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team gestaltest du die Produktstrategie ebenso aktiv mit wie die Umsetzung neuer Features und bringst moderne Technologien wie KI gezielt in die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro ein. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering, UX Design und internen Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst fundierte Produktentscheidungen auf Basis von Nutzerdaten, technischen Anforderungen und Marktanforderungen.

  • Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team innovative Features für Kliniken und Gesundheitseinrichtungen, von der Anfrage bis zur Buchung.

  • Du priorisierst das Product Backlog anhand von Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktanforderungen und relevanten Produkt-KPIs.

  • Du steuerst den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess von der Product Discovery über Delivery bis zum erfolgreichen Release.

  • Du arbeitest mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen und übersetzt Marktanforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen.

  • Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Buchungsdaten, leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab und optimierst kontinuierlich die Customer Journey auf doctari pro.

  • Du treibst den gezielten Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz im Produkt voran.


Deine Erfahrung & Persönlichkeit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS-, Plattform- oder Marketplace-Umfeld.

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte für Geschäftskunden: von der Product Discovery über nutzerzentriertes Design bis zur datengetriebenen Optimierung.

  • Technisches Verständnis, das tief genug geht, um Architekturentscheidungen zu verstehen, Trade-offs zu bewerten und mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe zu diskutieren.

  • Analytisches Denken, Pragmatismus sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Produkte und moderne Technologien, die du aktiv nutzt, um Produktmehrwert zu schaffen.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Account Management oder Customer Success ist ein klares Plus.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und fließende Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.


Das erwartet Dich

Bei uns übernimmst du echte Produktverantwortung für doctari pro, eine Plattform mit direktem Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität im deutschen Gesundheitssystem. Du gestaltest die Demand-Seite eines der größten medizinischen Marktplätze Deutschlands mit und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit unmittelbar in den Daten.

Darüber hinaus bieten wir eine Vielzahl an Benefits und Möglichkeiten, um Berufliches wie Privates gut zu vereinen:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Vertrauensarbeitszeit
  • Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket
  • Rabatte über Corporate Benefits
  • Zuschuss zum EGYM Wellpass


Komm zu uns!

  • Du unterstützt die langfristige Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung unserer Plattform – mit Blick auf Stabilität, Performance, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit.

Warum Xempus

  • Sehr attraktiver Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge

title: Principal Brand Designer (Spain or Portugal - based role)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Olx
description_html:
About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.


What you'll own

Define the future of OLX’s  Group's brand ecosystem

Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across  product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.


    What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust 

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design 

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills


    • Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.


    Hiring Process
    We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:
     
    First Stage 
    Portfolio & Design Leadership 
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

description_html:
Ready to build at the crossroads of Marketing Tech and Entertainment? 

JustWatch provides data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment industry. We build internal tools that help our campaign managers automate workflows and unlock innovative capabilities in entertainment marketing.

We’re hiring a Junior Product Manager for our MarTech team. This role is perfect for someone who is highly organised and can create clarity in an unstructured environment.

 
 

What you will be doing
  • Ensuring weekly progress toward quarterly goals.
  • Testing new releases hands-on, verifying behaviour, tracking issues, and scheduling fixes.
  • Monitoring product metrics and system health, flagging issues early.
  • Using our internal automation tools to understand real user workflows.
  • Stepping in quickly when issues surface to help coordinate a resolution.
  • Taking ownership of smaller product areas as you grow.

    • What you will NOT be doing
  • Jira administration or ticket shuffling - we work lightweight, and we optimise for speed.
  • Make meetings for the sake of process or ceremony.
  • Wait for work to fall on your desk - you’ll know what needs to be prioritised next.

    • What we need from you
  • You’re comfortable working with unclear problems and incomplete information, and can create structure on your own.
  • You keep work moving: follow up, unblock, prioritise, and ensure things ship.
  • You ask the right questions to unlock core pain points and strategise solutions.
  • You organise work using simple tools (Docs, Sheets), not PM frameworks or Jira workflows.
  • You can write development-ready project documents with no AI fluff.
  • You understand MarTech fundamentals (campaign workflows, tracking, automation, integrations) and why they’re complex.
  • You’re data-strong: you explore datasets, can use BI tools (e.g. Lightdash), and conclude.
  • You’re comfortable working close to technical systems: reading logs, debugging issues, understanding APIs, and supporting automation.
  • You’ve shipped before - a dashboard, tool, workflow, script, automation, or project.

    • What we offer you
  • You'll have a direct impact on how the global marketing campaigns are run.
  • You’ll see immediately how improvements (and mistakes) affect our bottom line.
  • Incredible learning opportunity. You’ll work closely with the MarTech PM, developers, and founders who are actively involved in shaping the company.
  • A culture built on autonomy, trust, and continuous iteration - not corporate ladder climbing.
  • A team that deeply cares about delivering results.

    • If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

    • A company culture that really works
    • Audience as a Service
    • Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog

    How to apply

    Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.

    Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.

    If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.

We are seeking a gifted and talented Account Excecutive to join our Berlin office.
 
This role involves engaging qualified strategic prospects, demoing the Aircall solution, providing technical assistance, successfully navigating a proof of concept and negotiating contracts. It is a fast-paced role that fits high energy and smart sales people.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Position and articulate the Aircall value proposition to your prospects;

About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The mission of the Senior Product Manager - Earn is to own and grow one of Ledger Live's core value pillars: helping millions of users put their crypto to work safely, directly from self-custody. You will define and drive the roadmap for Earn - spanning staking, stable yield savings, and partner-powered yield products - turning Ledger's security promise into a real, recurring source of value for our users and for the business.

What you’ll be doing:

title: Founding Data Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Meetdavis
description_html:
TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

title: Senior Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Forteil GmbH - bonify
description_html:
About us

Join bonify, Germany’s leading platform for credit scoring and financial management. We are on the mission to revolutionize the FinTech industry and make the credit score and financial data available and transparent for our users.

We are hiring a Senior Product Designer to shape how millions of users understand and improve their financial health across mobile and web.

You'll own design end-to-end for a defined product area, from framing the right problems through research, prototyping, validation, and delivery. Our focus is on creating more value beyond the credit score, making complex financial information feel simple, useful, and trustworthy, and embedding AI into both our products and our daily work.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a strong research mindset. You'll speak directly with German-speaking users, work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data, contribute to our design system, and support less experienced designers through collaboration and feedback.

Your tasks

  • Lead product design for a defined area across mobile and web.
  • Turn complex financial and credit-related information into experiences that feel simple, useful and trustworthy.
  • Plan and conduct customer research, interviews and usability testing, particularly with German-speaking users.
  • Translate qualitative research and behavioural data into clear product decisions.
  • Create user flows, interaction models, prototypes and polished product experiences in Figma.
  • Work closely with Engineering to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable and implemented with high quality.
  • Partner with Product and Data to define what success looks like and evaluate the impact of shipped work.
  • Contribute to and improve reusable patterns and our design system.
  • Use AI practically in your day-to-day work to accelerate research, exploration, prototyping and documentation.
  • Help shape AI-powered customer experiences where relevant — while applying strong judgement around trust, clarity and user control.
  • Share your expertise, give thoughtful feedback and help raise the quality of design across the team.

Requirements

  • You have around 6–8 years of experience in product design, ideally working on digital consumer products.
  • Strong experience designing end-to-end product experiences across mobile and web.
  • Advanced skills in Figma, interaction design and prototyping.
  • Strong hands-on user research experience — not only consuming research, but planning and conducting it yourself.
  • The ability to simplify complex, data-heavy or sensitive topics into clear customer experiences.
  • Strong product thinking and the ability to connect design decisions to customer and business outcomes.
  • Experience working closely with Product, Engineering and Data in cross-functional teams.
  • Confidence working independently and taking ownership from ambiguity through delivery.
  • German at C1 level or above, including the ability to conduct customer interviews and usability studies.
  • Strong practical experience using AI tools in your design workflow — for example in exploration, synthesis, prototyping or documentation.
  • A collaborative, kind and constructive working style.
  • Experience in fintech, banking, financial services or another regulated/data-intensive environment is a strong plus.

What we offer

As part of the bonify team, you'll have:

  • The opportunity to take ownership from day one
  • The chance to thrive in a dynamic and flexible startup environment.
  • Access to extensive coaching and training programs through our personal development budget
  • 30 vacation days
  • Subsidies for BVG and UrbanSportsClub
  • 1:1 language classes in both German and English.

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavourable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy, and maternity.

Please note, to be compliant with AML Offices, due to the specifics of fintech industries additional background checks are required (applicable only at the offer stage).

If you're ready to make a meaningful impact in the world of FinTech and embark on an exciting career journey, apply now to join bonify!

title: AI Content & Design Creator (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ZeinPharma Germany GmbH
description_html:
Wer wir sind:

Seit über 25 Jahren steht ZEINpharma für Mikronährstoffe in Premiumqualität. Heute umfasst das Produktportfolio über 170 Produkte – von Vitaminen, Mineralstoffen und Enzymen bis hin zu patentierten Spezialwirkstoffen. Als Familienunternehmen legen wir Wert auf erlesene Inhaltsstoffe, höchste Reinheit und die Formulierung unserer Produkte auf Basis neuester wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse. Entwicklung und Herstellung erfolgen aus einer Hand an unserem Unternehmensstandort im hessischen Nauheim – für Kunden in Deutschland und weltweit.

Was uns auszeichnet: Der Anspruch, Dinge neu und anders zu denken – kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für persönliche Gestaltung. ‚Jeder Tag ist Deiner' ist hierbei kein einfaches Versprechen. Wir suchen kreative, kluge und erfahrene Persönlichkeiten, die mit uns das tägliche ‚Plus' an Gesundheit weitergeben – an Menschen, die das Besondere suchen und für die ein gesundes und erfülltes Leben besonders wichtig ist.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle:

Unser Marketing-Team wächst weiter – Was jetzt fehlt, ist die Person, die Content und Design mit KI-Tools auf ein neues Produktions-Level hebt: schneller, skalierbarer und mit einem Qualitätsanspruch, der sich nicht anlesen lässt, sondern aus echter Tool-Erfahrung kommt. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Senior Art Director zusammen und übersetzt Kampagnen- und Contentkonzepte in Bild, Bewegtbild und automatisierte Content-Pipelines.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Konzeption und Produktion von Grafiken, Social-Media-Content, Ad Creatives und Produktvisuals mit KI-Tools (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, DALL·E, Photoshop Generative Fill)
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Art Director und Content Marketing Manager – Umsetzung von Kampagnen- und Contentkonzepten in Bild- und Videosprache
  • Aufbau und Pflege KI-gestützter Content-Workflows und Automatisierungen (Template-Systeme, Batch-Produktion, Content-Pipelines)
  • Video- und Bewegtbild-Content mit KI-Tools (Runway, Sora, CapCut AI o. Ä.) für Social Media und Ads
  • Evaluierung und Einführung neuer KI-Tools für Design, Content und Automatisierung
  • Sicherstellung von Markenkonsistenz und Qualität bei allen KI-generierten Assets

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Ausbildung/Studium im Bereich Grafikdesign, Mediengestaltung, Kommunikationsdesign oder vergleichbar – Quereinstieg mit starkem Portfolio ist willkommen
  • Praktische, hands-on Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Bild- und Videogenerierung (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, DALL·E, Runway o. Ä.)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere)
  • Verständnis für Prompting und Workflow-Automatisierung (z. B. n8n, Zapier, Make) von Vorteil
  • Gespür für Marken- und Bildsprache sowie hohe Qualitätsansprüche an das eigene Ergebnis
  • Proaktive, experimentierfreudige Arbeitsweise – du testest neue Tools, bevor andere überhaupt davon gehört haben

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

  • Die Chance, KI-gestützte Content-Produktion bei ZEINpharma von Grund auf zu prägen – kein Verwalten von Bestehendem, sondern echtes Aufbauen
  • Modernes, neues Büro in Rüsselsheim, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung
  • Budget für Tools, Lizenzen und Weiterbildung im KI-Bereich
  • 50 % Mitarbeiterrabatt auf alle ZEINpharma-Produkte sowie Zugang zu Corporate Benefits
  • Hochmoderne, höhenverstellbare Büroausstattung, Mitarbeiterparkplätze und kostenlose Getränke

Du möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden?

Wolltest du schon immer zeigen, was KI-gestütztes Design wirklich leisten kann – statt nur darüber zu reden? Und legst du Wert auf ein innovatives Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für persönliche Entwicklung?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Bei uns zählen Leidenschaft für Gesundheit, für das Besondere, unternehmerisches Denken und die Lust, Dinge wirklich voranzubringen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Event Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at REP Revenue Excellence Partners
description_html:
Willkommen bei REP – Revenue Excellence Partners

Wir helfen B2B-Unternehmen dabei, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum zu erzielen – mit strategischer Beratung, operativer Stärke und technologischem Know-how. Als Partner für Go-to-Market-Exzellenz stehen wir für einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz im Sales Outbound.

Um unser Wachstum weiter voranzutreiben, suchen wir eine Event Managerin (m/w/d) mit Gespür für kuratierte Formate, Organisationstalent und Ownership für unsere Kunden- und Speaker-Events.

📍 Standort: Berlin
Start: ab sofort

Aufgaben

In dieser Position bist du für unsere kuratierten Kunden- und Zielkunden-Events verantwortlich und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Gründer auf den richtigen Bühnen stehen. Die Rolle bietet dir die Möglichkeit, ein Format von Grund auf mitzugestalten, das Teil unserer Go-to-Market-Strategie ist.

  • Du konzipierst und verantwortest unsere kuratierten Kundenveranstaltungen – Dinner-Formate, Panels und ggf. eigene kleine Formate, die wir gemeinsam entwickeln.
  • Von der Gästeliste über Location, Ablauf und Dienstleister bis zur Durchführung vor Ort liegt jedes Event komplett in deiner Hand.
  • Du identifizierst die Bühnen – Konferenzen, Panels, Podcasts –, auf denen unsere Gründer Autorität zeigen sollten, und verantwortest Bewerbungen und Anfragen.
  • Du koordinierst Podcast-Termine und steuerst die gesamte Logistik drumherum: Reise, Vorbereitung, Timing, Nachbereitung.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und stellst sicher, dass jedes Format zur Positionierung von REP passt.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Eventmanagement, Kommunikation, Marketing oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation.
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Organisation von Events im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise mit kuratierten Kleinformaten (Dinner, Roundtables, Panels) statt Massenveranstaltungen.
  • Erfahrung im souveränen Umgang mit Senior-Stakeholdern (Geschäftsführung, VP Sales) sowie mit Speaker-Büros und Veranstaltern.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Budgets, Dienstleistern und Timelines – du behältst bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.
  • Organisationstalent, strukturierte und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise – von der Gästeliste bis ins letzte Logistikdetail.
  • Kommunikationsstark verbunden mit einem hohen Maß an Proaktivität, Diskretion und einem Gespür für das richtige Format und die richtige Gästeliste.
  • Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeit in deutscher Sprache und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • 100 % Remote möglich für den administrativen Teil – arbeite von wo du willst, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz vor Ort in Berlin für Events. Wir leben Vertrauen statt Kontrolle, bei uns zählt, was du bewirkst, nicht wann oder wo du arbeitest.
  • State-of-the-art Equipment und Software – damit du effizient und reibungslos arbeiten kannst.
  • Ein Team mit Haltung: offen, hilfsbereit und ambitioniert – und ganz ohne Ellbogen. Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Verantwortung sind Teil unserer REP-DNA.
  • Ein vielfältiges Kundenspektrum – von StartUp bis Mittelstand, aus Tech, SaaS, Industrie, Consulting & mehr. Bei uns kommt keine Langeweile auf und du bekommst vielfältige Einblicke in verschiedene Geschäftsmodelle und Märkte.

Klingt nach dir?
Dann freuen wir uns, von dir zu hören!

Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, ein paar Sätzen zu deiner Motivation, Gehaltsvorstellungen sowie möglichem Startdatum. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Art Director oder Senior Designer – idealerweise in Agentur und/oder Inhouse im FMCG-, Health-, Pharma- oder Beauty-Umfeld
  • Aussagekräftiges Portfolio mit Packaging- und Kampagnenarbeiten
  • Sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop), Kenntnisse in Figma und fundiertes Verständnis von Druckvorstufe und Reinzeichnung
  • Gespür für einen Premium-Markenauftritt, Typografie und aktuelle Trends – Erfahrung mit E-Commerce-Assets wie Amazon A+ Content ist ein echter Pluspunkt
  • Offenheit für KI-gestützte Bild- und Contentproduktion (z. B. Adobe Firefly, Midjourney) als Werkzeug im Kreativprozess
  • Hands-on-Mentalität mit strategischem Blick: Du denkst Marke im Großen und setzt im Detail um – auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

  • Die Chance, den Auftritt einer etablierten, wachsenden Marke sichtbar zu prägen – mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung
  • Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • 50 % Mitarbeiterrabatt auf alle ZEINpharma-Produkte

description_html:
Als Senior CRM Manager (m/w/d) gestaltest du unsere komplette Klaviyo-Welt, von der ersten Willkommensmail bis zum Winback-Flow. Du sorgst dafür, dass sich unsere Kund:innen im Abo wie im Einzelkauf gut begleitet fühlen und zur richtigen Zeit die richtige Nachricht bekommen.

Du bist verantwortlich für unseren gesamten Kampagnenkalender in Klaviyo, von der Planung bis zum Versand, und entwickelst unsere Flow-Journey Schritt für Schritt weiter. Ein Schwerpunkt liegt auf unseren Abo-Kund:innen: Mit gezielten Retention- und Subscription-Flows erkennst du Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig und gewinnst Kund:innen zurück. Dafür nutzt du durchdachte Segmente und AI-gestützte Workflows, damit unsere Kommunikation relevanter wird und wir gleichzeitig schneller umsetzen.

Du arbeitest in unserem CRM-Team und berichtest an unsere Head of CRM.

Aufgaben

Campaign Management in Klaviyo

  • Du verantwortest alle Kampagnen für unsere Märkte DE/AT und CH, vom Briefing über Copy und Segmentauswahl bis zu Versandzeitpunkt und A/B-Testing.
  • Heute liegt der Fokus auf E-Mail. Mittelfristig kommen Kanäle wie Push, In-App, Print und eventuell WhatsApp dazu.

Flows und Automationen

  • Core-Flows: Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Browse Abandonment und Winback. Du baust sie auf, lokalisierst sie für alle Märkte und optimierst sie laufend.
  • Retention- & Loyalty-Flows: Next Purchase Activation, Reactivation, Loyalty, Wishlist, Reviews und weitere. Du hältst sie aktuell und erweiterst sie kontinuierlich.

Segmentierung & Targeting

  • Du entwickelst die Segment-Logik in Klaviyo: Lifecycle-Phasen, Abo vs. Einzelkauf, Sales- und Reminder-Zielgruppen sowie Kund:innen mit hohem LTV.

Launches & Sales-Aktionen

  • Du setzt Teaser-, Launch- und Reminder-Strecken für neue Produkte und Aktionen in allen Märkten um.

Reporting & Optimierung

  • Du behältst die Performance von Kampagnen, Flows und Abo-KPIs im Blick und leitest daraus konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung: Mind. 5 Jahre Erfahrung im CRM- oder E-Mail-Marketing, davon nachweislich hands-on in Klaviyo.
  • Subscription-Know-how: Du hast Erfahrung mit Abo-Modellen und weißt, wie man Kündigungen verhindert und Abo-Kund:innen zurückgewinnt, idealerweise mit Loop oder einem vergleichbaren Subscription-Tool.
  • Flow- & Kampagnen-Know-how: Du hast schon Automation-Flows aufgebaut und weißt, wie Segmentierung und Lifecycle-Marketing zusammenspielen.
  • Copywriting: Du schreibst starke, markengerechte Texte auf Deutsch und lokalisierst sie sicher für den Schweizer Markt.
  • Zahlenaffinität: Du liest Campaign- und Flow-Reports selbstständig und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab.
  • Digital & hands-on: Du bist offen für AI-Tools und neue Workflows und testest lieber, als lange zu diskutieren.
  • Organisation: Du behältst bei 2 Märkten und zwei Kunden-Logiken (Abo & Einzelkauf) den Überblick und arbeitest strukturiert.
  • Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Full Remote: Du arbeitest innerhalb Deutschlands im Home-Office.
  • Urlaub: 28 Tage pro Jahr
  • Neueste Apple Hardware zum Start

Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Starttermin. Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Anne Freese (https://www.linkedin.com/in/anne-freese-2a70728b/).

title: Director, Influencer Strategy
description_html:
Director, Influencer Strategy

LOCATION

The Director, Influencer Strategy position is a remote, work from home position, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. (a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, and conferences.

THE ROLE

Acceleration Partners is building out its influencer strategy discipline, and this role sits at the center of that effort. The Director, Influencer Strategy is a senior, externally-facing position responsible for shaping how AP goes to market with influencer programs. This person works at the intersection of sales, client services, and delivery, helping the business win new clients, build credible influencer strategies, and connect execution back to measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings deep fluency in the brand-awareness and affiliate influencer space, strong business instincts, and the ability to work across internal teams to ensure that what we deliver compelling strategic programs that are successfully executed for our clients. A working knowledge of affiliate marketing is a plus; some learning curve on the affiliate side is expected and supported.

TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

STRATEGY-LED SALES ENABLEMENT

Partners with the sales and delivery teams from the moment an opportunity comes in. Based on the prospect’s needs and goals, the Strategist owns building a credible, well-reasoned influencer strategy for proposals and RFPs. The Strategist will use thought-leadership and industry insights to define the appropriate creator strategy and the program’s direction – including audience insights, competitive analysis, creative positioning, influencer archetype creation, messaging frameworks, and platform recommendations. Works with delivery to ensure what is proposed is grounded in what can be delivered, budget, and scope. Joins pitch meetings alongside the sales lead and client services point person to speak to the strategy with authority and expertise. Answer client questions thoughtfully, showcasing a deep knowledge of the influencer space, examples of competitive programs, and creator best practices.

PROGRAM STRATEGY & INDUSTRY INTELLIGENCE

Define the strategy for robust, in-depth influencer programs grounded in industry research and competitive intelligence. Stays current on what brands across categories are doing in the influencer and affiliate space, tracking trends, emerging platforms, and talent ecosystems. Supports program launches and provides the strategic foundation that the delivery team executes against.

INDUSTRY LEADING REPORTING

Adds narrative and strategic context to reporting, connecting the dots between the strategy sold, the execution delivered, performance results, and forward-looking recommendations. Right now reporting is data-driven but lacks the strategic thread that ties it together. This role closes that gap and creates upsell opportunities in the process.

ONGOING CLIENT SUPPORT & UPSELL

Plugs in throughout the client lifecycle to provide strategic recommendations, industry thought-leadership, and pitching the strategy for expansion opportunities. Presents to clients alongside the delivery team on specialized program recommendations, optimizations, or expansions. Work on a diverse portfolio of brands, serving as a partner and resource to the delivery team and clients.

AP MARKETING & EXTERNAL PRESENCE

Contributes to AP’s external marketing through internal and external thought leadership. Opportunity to be featured in AP’s marketing efforts such as speaking at or attending conferences on influencer strategy topics. Helps build AP’s profile and credibility in the influencer space and inspire clients to believe in our strategic capabilities and knowledge base.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

BY 6 MONTHS...

You have a strong grasp of AP’s influencer offerings and sales process having contributed to multiple pitches. You are producing influencer strategy decks that the sales team is confident presenting to prospects. You have established working relationships with client services leads and understand how strategy translates into delivery. You are adding narrative context and future recommendations to client reports.

BY 1 YEAR...

You are a recognized internal resource for influencer strategy across the business. Your strategic program recommendations are being successfully delivered on with positive client feedback. The influencer pitch process runs more smoothly because of your involvement, and win rates on influencer opportunities are improving. Client reports have a cleaner strategic narrative and we see more clients opting into expansion opportunities. You are actively contributing to AP’s external presence through content or speaking, and you have identified and helped close at least one meaningful upsell opportunity.

QUALITIES OF THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Brings a clear strategic point of view and can defend it in a room with senior clients and leadership
  • Equally comfortable building a deck and presenting it; thinks in narratives, but understands the tactics
  • Collaborative by instinct; understands that the best outcomes come from working across and with teams
  • Stays current on the influencer and creator space without being prompted; this is something they follow because they care about it in order to have a consistent pulse on the Influencer industry, brand activations, and social trends
  • Can operate with autonomy, ambiguity and ownership in a discipline that is still being built out
  • Reliable and able to effectively prioritize to hit deadlines
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, including with senior internal and external audiences
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, client-facing, agency environment working across multiple clients in different verticals

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • 7+ years of experience in influencer marketing, with meaningful exposure to strategy, program buildout, or new business
  • Demonstrated ability to build and present influencer strategies in a business development or client-facing context
  • Deep knowledge of the influencer and creator ecosystem across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Substack, and emerging channels
  • Working knowledge of affiliate marketing is a plus; willingness to learn is required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce client-ready materials independently
  • Ability to synthesize and visualize information effectively independently or in collaboration with Design
  • Experience presenting to senior clients or speaking externally preferred
  • Bachelors degree required
  • Ability to travel as needed for client meetings, team gatherings, and industry conferences

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, AP’s global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that connect brands to the right consumers through affiliate and influencer All of our work is supported by APVision, our proprietary technology suite which leverages the largest dataset of any agency in the Partnership Marketing agency ecosystem. Serving over 200 brands—including household names like Amazon, Apple, Target, Google, Marriott, Coinbase, and Burberry—AP’s diversified team is creating what’s next in the industry by building high-performing partnership marketing programs. As the only truly integrated global partnerships agency, AP prides itself on being at the cutting edge of industry developments and leveraging proven expertise to deliver unique solutions for brands seeking sustainable growth.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER

  • 100% remote work for everyone
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
  • 401K with matching
  • Open Paid Time Off
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
  • Focus Fridays
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!

Target base salary is $110-130K + bonus depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

 

#LI-REMOTE 

*GLSDR

title: Contract Staff Front End Engineer (Web Conference/Screen Sharing)
description_html:
About the team and role

Mozilla's Web Conferencing team owns the media capture and sharing features that make Firefox work for video calls: screen, window, and tab capture, and the interface users interact with when they share content in Google Meet, Zoom, or Jitsi.

We're bringing a set of screensharing improvements to Firefox. The backend work is complete and the UX has been designed and approved. We're looking for a front-end engineer on a fixed-term contract to implement it and ship it.

What you'll do

  • Implement approved UX designs for Firefox's screen, window, and tab sharing experience, and see them through to release
  • Build browser UI that holds up in a large, widely used codebase: tested, accessible, and localizable
  • Work with UX on the cases a design didn't anticipate, and with QA on validating the result
  • Support partner testing against major web conferencing services
  • Land your work in mozilla-central through public code review on Phabricator

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years building production user interfaces with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Experience implementing an approved design faithfully, plus the judgment to flag it when the design meets a case it didn't anticipate
  • Ability to get productive quickly in a large, mature codebase you didn't write
  • Experience writing automated tests for user interfaces
  • Strong asynchronous written communication, since the team is distributed across timezones
  • Comfort working in public, since Bugzilla and Phabricator are open

Bonus qualifications

  • Prior contributions to Firefox or another open-source browser
  • Familiarity with Firefox front-end architecture: browser/, custom elements, XUL, Fluent localization
  • Experience with WebRTC or getDisplayMedia
  • Accessibility experience with modal dialogs and list navigation
  • Experience with Mozilla's test frameworks (browser-chrome, mochitest)
  • Experience using AI tooling effectively in front-end development
  • Open source environment experience

Hiring Ranges:

Canada Tier 1 Locations

$145,000—$170,800 CAD

Canada Tier 2 Locations

$154,000—$168,000 USD

title: Telemedicine Physician Consultant
description_html:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time, fully remote physician consultants who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across multiple U.S. states. Depending on your licensure, certification, and area of expertise, you will provide consultations in menopause and perimenopause care aligned to The Menopause Society and ACOG guidelines, early fertility support aligned to ACOG and ASRM guidelines, or both.

Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. Weight, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic risk are central to outcomes across every journey we support, from ovulatory function and preconception readiness to menopausal symptom burden and long-term cardiovascular and bone health. You should expect metabolic assessment and management to be a routine part of your visits, and clinicians comfortable prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists, within clinical protocols are especially encouraged to apply.

This is a flexible, part-time contractor engagement of approximately 5-40 hours per week, with a target commitment of 10-15 hours per week.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Provide virtual consultations (video and/or phone) within your area(s) of expertise, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing management of menopausal, fertility, and related hormonal and metabolic concerns.
  • Apply current ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines with individualized, shared decision-making.
  • Assess and manage metabolic health as a routine part of visits, including prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications such as GLP-1 receptor agonists within clinical protocols where appropriate.
  • Document visits accurately and on time, order and interpret relevant labs, and coordinate referrals to primary care, OB/GYN, endocrinology, behavioral health, or subspecialists as needed.
  • Maintain active, unrestricted multi-state clinical licensure, complete credentialing and payer enrollment, and maintain eligibility for additional state licenses to expand coverage.
  • Contribute to member experience and quality through strong virtual visit presence, effective use of telehealth and EHR systems, participation in chart audits and case reviews, and staying current with emerging research and regulatory changes.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a consistent panel of high-quality virtual visits within your clinical area(s), with strong member experience and visit quality results.
  • Maintained timely, accurate documentation and lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.
  • Expanded your state licensure coverage in line with program needs, supporting broader member access.
  • Integrated metabolic assessment and management, including GLP-1 protocols where clinically appropriate, as a routine part of your visits.
  • Contributed to chart audits, case reviews, and clinical protocol refinement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • An MD or DO in Obstetrics/Gynecology, Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI), Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Endocrinology; or you are a Physician Assistant (PA) or Advanced Practice Registered Nurse/Nurse Practitioner (e.g., WHNP, adult/gerontology NP, FNP) with demonstrated expertise in the applicable clinical area.
  • A minimum of 3-5+ years of active clinical experience in early fertility support, menopause care, or both, including evaluation, treatment, and longitudinal management.
  • An active, unrestricted U.S. medical license; multi-state licensure is preferred and IMLC participation is strongly preferred.
  • For clinicians practicing in the menopause specialty: MSCP certification from The Menopause Society, or certification actively in progress with a clear completion plan.
  • Familiarity with ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines.
  • Prior telemedicine experience (preferred), with comfort managing visits entirely in a virtual environment and a strong virtual presence that supports shared decision-making over video and phone.
  • Proficiency with telehealth technologies, including video platforms, secure messaging, electronic prescribing, and EHR/clinical documentation tools.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, along with a HIPAA-compliant home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Clinical experience spanning both early fertility and menopause, enabling flexible coverage across member journeys.
  • Experience working in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, or comparable specialty program.
  • Familiarity with early fertility workup, including AMH testing, ovulation induction, and preconception optimization, with appropriate escalation to in-person ART evaluation.
  • Experience prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists (titration, side-effect management, monitoring, and discontinuation planning); obesity medicine training or ABOM certification is a significant advantage.
  • Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.
  • Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals.
  • Fluency in an additional language.

Why This Role Matters

Carrot's telemedicine clinic is one of the most direct ways members experience our care. Every virtual visit shapes how members navigate some of the most personal moments of their lives, from trying to conceive to managing menopause. The clinicians in this network are the face of that experience, and the quality of their judgment, communication, and documentation determines whether members receive care they trust.

This role also anchors Carrot's clinical point of view that metabolic health is inseparable from reproductive and hormonal health. As the telemedicine program scales across states and journeys, the clinicians who join this network will directly expand access to guideline-aligned, whole-person care for members who often cannot find it locally.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Compensation:

title: Lead Automation Engineer
description_html:
We’re Capital on Tap
Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started!

The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €65,000 - €75,000

Quality Engineering at Capital on Tap

Quality Engineering is embedded across our mission teams, partnering with Engineering, Product, and UX to champion quality at every stage of the software lifecycle. We build quality in from the start - not bolt it on at the end.

The Lead Automation Engineer is a critical, hands-on role embedded within a Mission team. Reporting functionally to your mission team’s Lead, you will be the quality champion for your specific feature set. You will leverage standardised automation tooling to maximise test coverage, accelerate delivery velocity, and maintain the highest quality standards for our products.

What You'll Be Doing ️

Mission Team Quality Ownership & Strategy

  • Define and own the comprehensive testing strategy for your domain (e.g., payments, banking, onboarding), ensuring end-to-end quality and compliance in partnership with the QA Team Lead.
  • Act as the primary contributor for automation; design, develop, and maintain robust automated tests (API, UI, Mobile).
  • Champion a "Shift-Left" mindset, working with Product Owners and Developers from the refinement stage to ensure quality is engineered in from the start.
  • Directly manage the mission team’s automation targets and use data-driven insights (MTTD/MTTR, defect escape rates) to predict high-risk areas.

Technical Leadership & Tooling Adoption

  • Serve as the mission team's expert on central automation frameworks, driving consistent adoption of CI/CD processes and quality gates.
  • Identify team-specific gaps and collaborate with the central Tooling Team to develop custom helpers or data generators that enhance the core framework.
  • Ensure automated test suites are fully integrated into CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable deployment and a "fail fast" mechanism.
  • Coordinate complex technical testing, including microservices, security (OWASP ZAP), and performance testing.

Collaboration, Coaching & AI Innovation

  • Coach and upskill developers and junior QA engineers on automation best practices and test design patterns.
  • Champion the use of AI tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot) for complex tasks like architecture exploration, incident investigation, and test generation.
  • Leverage component testing, service virtualization, and contract testing to reduce dependencies and enable independent team testing.
  • Define test data strategies and environment requirements to support both automated and exploratory testing.

Our Values & Culture

  • Just Pilot: We never settle for “good enough”. We pilot new ideas fast, ask questions to figure it out, and scale quickly.
  • Why Not Today? Fast is as slow as we go - speed and simplicity gives us a competitive advantage.
  • Be a Buddy: We tap in from day one to help the team, we do the right thing even if it’s hard.
  • Owners and Dates: We don’t chase people. If you own a task and agree to a date, the expectation is that it gets done.
  • Feedback: We want our employees to flourish, so we regularly provide direct and constructive feedback.

We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years in QA Automation/SDET roles with proven success leading quality within an Agile team.
  • Programming: Strong proficiency in modern languages essential for automation, specifically C# or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Fintech Expertise: Experience testing complex financial systems (card issuing, transaction processing, or credit risk).
  • Automation Mastery: Hands-on experience with tools for UI (Playwright, Cypress) and API (REST Assured, Other API testing frameworks).
  • Cloud & CI/CD: Familiarity with Azure, Git, and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.
  • Leadership: Ability to influence without authority, encouraging developers and POs to prioritise automation and quality.

Even if you don’t have all of the necessary skills, we still encourage you to apply.

Interview Process

  • First stage: 30-minute intro, CV review, and values with Talent Partner
  • Second stage: 45-minute “Tech Chat” with Team Manager
  • Final stage: 60-minute Code Pairing + 30-minute Stakeholder Interview with Engineering & Product

Diversity & Inclusion
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks

Check out our benefits:

Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare
Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)
Paid Car Parking
️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)
Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget
6 free therapy sessions per year
Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Other Info
Check out our ‘Top Tips’ for interviewing.
✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin.
Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions.

Excited to work here? Apply!
If you’d like to progress your career within our fast growing, profitable fintech then click apply and we will aim to get back to you within 3 working days (during busy periods this could take up to 5 working days.)
