title: Director, Channel Partnerships
description_html:
Director, Channel Partnerships

Location:

The Director, Channel Partnerships is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Candidates should be based in the U.S.

Role Purpose:

Acceleration Partners is seeking a commercially-minded Strategic Partnerships leader to build and grow a high-value agency partner ecosystem that generates measurable business growth. This role owns both the health of our existing strategic partnerships and the development of new relationships that create pipeline, revenue and market influence. Working across Sales, Marketing, Strategy and Client Services, this person will ensure partnerships become a scalable commercial growth channel rather than simply a network of relationships.

The Opportunity:

The role has two equally important priorities:
• Own and optimize AP's existing portfolio of strategic and technology partnerships, ensuring every relationship has clear objectives, governance and commercial value.
• Build new partnerships across adjacent ecosystems—including AI, retail media, social commerce, consultancies, agencies, technology providers and investors—that create new routes to market and commercial opportunity.

Success will be measured by pipeline generated, revenue influenced, strength of strategic relationships and the market intelligence brought back into the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Existing Partnership Management

  • Own AP's portfolio of strategic and vendor partnerships.
  • Implement a structured framework for partnership health, governance, renewals and executive engagement.
  • Identify underperforming relationships and create recovery plans.
  • Own referral routing and ensure opportunities progress through the commercial pipeline.

New Partnership Development

  • Identify and secure new strategic partners across adjacent markets.
  • Build executive relationships and create joint business plans, referral programmes and co-selling opportunities.
  • Identify when relationships should evolve into formal commercial agreements and support negotiations.
  • Continuously identify emerging partnership opportunities and strategic whitespace.

Commercial & Revenue Accountability

  • Own partner-sourced pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Measure both introductions created and commercial outcomes delivered.
  • Report performance and recommend investment priorities.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales on target accounts, introductions and joint pursuits.
  • Work with Marketing on co-marketing, events, webinars and thought leadership.
  • Collaborate with Strategy and Client Services to ensure partner activity aligns with client needs and market opportunities.

Market Intelligence & External Representation

  • Represent AP at conferences and industry events.
  • Become a recognized industry voice within the partnership ecosystem.
  • Bring back competitor intelligence, AI developments, customer trends and partnership opportunities to influence strategy and propositions.

Skills & Experience:

  • 7+ years in partnerships, alliances, business development or related roles.
  • Services / consulting industry experience is preferred
  • Demonstrated ownership of pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of strategic partnerships.
  • Excellent executive relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Commercially minded with strong organizational discipline.
  • Experience in digital marketing, affiliate, retail media or marketing technology desirable.
  • Willingness to travel and represent AP externally.

Measures of Success:

  • Partner-sourced pipeline and revenue.
  • Health and commercial value of strategic partnerships.
  • New strategic partnerships established.
  • Joint go-to-market initiatives delivered.
  • Market intelligence adopted internally.
  • Brand visibility and industry influence.

Success in the First Year:

Within the first 90 days, develop a clear view of all existing partnerships, implement a governance framework and priorities improvements. Within the first year, establish new strategic relationships, convert opportunities into measurable pipeline and revenue, and create a sustainable operating rhythm between Partnerships, Sales, Marketing and Strategy.

AP Perks and Benefits:

  • 100% remote work for everyone
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
  • 401K with matching
  • Open Paid Time Off
  • Summer and Holiday company-wide shutdown days in July and December
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
  • Focus Fridays
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits
  • Wellness, Technology, and Education Allowances
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more

Salary: The target base salary range is $110-130K + commissions/incentive plan depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

title: Telemedicine Registered Nurse (RN), Consultant
description_html:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time to full-time, fully remote Registered Nurses who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across all U.S. states. As an RN in this network, you are often the first clinical touchpoint for members navigating fertility, menopause, hormonal, and metabolic health journeys, providing triage, education, care coordination, and documentation that shape the entire care experience.

All work in this role is performed within RN scope of practice. RNs provide triage, education, care coordination, and documentation; they do not diagnose, do not prescribe, and do not independently modify a treatment plan. Anything requiring clinical judgment beyond RN scope is routed to a physician, so sound escalation judgment is central to the role.

This is a contractor engagement of approximately 20-40 hours per week, with scheduled shifts within the Monday-Friday, 8:00a-6:00p CST coverage window.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as the first clinical reviewer of inbound member messages, triaging for urgency, escalating to a physician when needed, and routing non-clinical threads to the appropriate support team.
  • Deliver member education on menopause staging, hormone therapy, preconception health, metabolic health, and medication administration.
  • Review and triage incoming lab results, escalate critical findings per protocol, retrieve outside records, and coordinate specialist referrals.
  • Manage pharmacy callbacks and prior authorizations in coordination with the care team.
  • Document all clinically relevant interactions same-day, create tracked internal tasks with named owners, and follow established escalation pathways.
  • Maintain active NLC multi-state licensure, complete required credentialing and onboarding, and adhere to HIPAA, continuing education, and liability coverage requirements.
  • Contribute to chart audits and clinical protocol feedback as the telemedicine program scales.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a consistent record of accurate, protocol-aligned triage with appropriate physician escalation and no missed critical lab values.
  • Maintained same-day documentation and timely lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.
  • Delivered high-quality member education across menopause, preconception, hormone therapy, and metabolic health topics, reflected in strong member experience results.
  • Managed care coordination workflows reliably within your coverage window, including referrals, records retrieval, prior authorizations, and pharmacy callbacks.
  • Contributed to chart audits, protocol feedback, and quality improvement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • An active, unrestricted RN license with NLC (Nurse Licensure Compact) multi-state privileges, in good standing, plus an ADN or BSN from an accredited program (BSN preferred).
  • A minimum of 3 years of active RN clinical experience, with meaningful experience in women's health, reproductive health, OB/GYN, fertility, endocrinology, or menopause care.
  • Demonstrated nurse triage experience, including assessing urgency, applying protocol, escalating appropriately, and recognizing critical lab values.
  • A clear understanding of RN scope of practice and sound judgment about when to escalate.
  • Strong written communication for asynchronous messaging and a strong phone presence for symptom assessment and instruction.
  • Proficiency with EHR and telehealth systems, secure messaging, and e-fax workflows.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • The ability to commit to scheduled shifts within the Monday-Friday, 8:00a-6:00p CST coverage window, with a HIPAA-compliant, private home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, REI practice, or comparable specialty program.
  • Familiarity with preconception and fertility workup, including AMH and hormone panels, ovulation tracking, and cycle-monitoring labs.
  • Hormone therapy education experience, including prior authorization workflows.
  • Experience supporting members on anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists.
  • Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.
  • Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals.
  • Relevant certification (e.g., MSCP through The Menopause Society, RNC-OB) and/or fluency in an additional language.

Why This Role Matters

Carrot's RN network is the front line of the telemedicine clinic. RNs are typically the first clinician a member reaches, and the quality of their triage judgment, education, and follow-through directly determines member safety, trust, and the experience of care during some of the most personal moments of members' lives.

This role also keeps the clinical program running well as it scales. Reliable triage, same-day documentation, and disciplined escalation protect physician capacity for the decisions that require it, while expanding access to guideline-aligned fertility, menopause, and metabolic health support for members who often cannot find it locally.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $40-$50/ hr. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

title: Senior Implementation Project Manager
description_html:
Who We Are

Launchpad Technologies Inc. is a global technology partner connecting top talent with high-impact projects across North America and beyond. We specialize in Staff Augmentation and product development, helping companies scale with agility while empowering professionals to grow in meaningful, remote-first environments.

About the Role

Launchpad Technologies is looking for an experienced Senior Implementation Project Manager to join our Professional Services team and lead software implementation projects for international customers. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who knows how to take ownership of an implementation from kickoff through Go-Live and stabilization, keeping customers, consultants, technical teams, and external partners aligned throughout the process.

You’ll serve as a central point of coordination across multiple stakeholders, managing scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, escalations, and customer expectations while ensuring projects continue moving toward successful delivery.

We’re particularly interested in professionals who have managed software implementations in ERP, financial systems, enterprise applications, or comparable environments. You do not need to be a Functional Consultant or configure the software yourself, but you should understand how software implementation projects work and be comfortable coordinating functional and technical teams.

Start date: September 2026
Contract type: Contractor, Full-Time, 100% Remote
Work hours: Monday to Friday, 7.00 am to 4.00 pm PST

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own software implementation projects from kickoff through Go-Live and post-production stabilization.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and priorities.
  • Act as a primary point of contact for customers throughout project delivery.
  • Coordinate work across Functional Consultants, Technical Consultants, developers, QA resources, customer teams, and third-party partners.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and potential delivery impacts.
  • Manage scope changes and ensure their impact on timelines, effort, and deliverables is clearly understood and communicated.
  • Lead customer status meetings and maintain clear, consistent stakeholder communication.
  • Manage customer expectations and facilitate escalations when projects encounter challenges.
  • Drive accountability for actions, decisions, deliverables, and follow-ups across project stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with shared resources while balancing priorities across different engagements.
  • Support successful handover following Go-Live and stabilization.

What You Need to Succeed

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of Project Management experience, with substantial experience managing software implementation projects.
  • Proven ownership of projects across the implementation lifecycle, from planning/kickoff through Go-Live.
  • Strong experience managing scope, timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies, changes, and deliverables.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong customer-facing experience, including status communication, expectation management, difficult conversations, and escalations.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and prioritize effectively in a dynamic delivery environment.
  • Strong collaboration and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to remain composed, pragmatic, and solution-oriented when projects encounter pressure or ambiguity.
  • Advanced English for leading meetings and communicating independently with international customers.

Nice-to-haves

  • Project Management experience within ERP, Finance, Accounting, enterprise software, or Professional Services implementations.
  • Familiarity with financial software implementation environments.
  • Experience working with distributed or international delivery teams.
  • PMP, Scrum, Agile, or other Project Management certifications.

A specific ERP, financial platform, certification, or academic degree is not required. We care primarily about demonstrated software implementation delivery experience and strong Project Management judgment.

Our Recruitment Process

Here’s what to expect from our candidate-friendly interview process. Our goal is to keep the process focused, transparent, and respectful of your time, while giving both sides enough space to determine whether there’s a strong mutual fit.

  1. Initial Interview – Talent Acquisition (60 minutes): A conversation focused on your implementation Project Management experience, project ownership, customer-facing responsibilities, collaboration style, English communication skills, and career goals. We’ll also provide full details about the opportunity and working conditions.

  2. Final Interview – Hiring Manager (60 minutes): A deeper discussion with Professional Services leadership focused on your Project Management expertise, delivery experience, judgment, communication, and approach to leading software implementations.

Why Join Launchpad?

We believe that great work starts with great people. At Launchpad, we offer:

  • Fully remote work with hardware provided
  • Global team experience with clients in North America
  • USD 3800-4200 monthly compensation
  • Training and learning stipends
  • Paid Time Off (vacation, personal, study)
  • ‍♂️ A culture that values autonomy, purpose, and human connection

Compliance & Equal Opportunity

Launchpad is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable laws in Canada and British Columbia.

All candidate information will be handled confidentially and used solely for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

Ready to make your mark? Apply now and be part of something exciting!

title: Working Student / Intern – Industrialization Land / UGV (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Quantum-Systems GmbH
description_html:
As a Working Student or Intern (m/f/d) in the field of Land Systems / UGV Industrialization, you will support our team in Göppingen in establishing serial production for unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs). You will work closely with the Industrialization team and our external consulting partners, taking responsibility for clearly defined work packages in documentation, data management, and production planning preparation.

You will collaborate across Production, Engineering, Quality, and Logistics, gaining first-hand experience of a real production ramp-up from the very beginning and seeing how a prototype-based setup evolves into a scalable and repeatable serial production process.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Support the shopfloor planning activities at our Göppingen site by documenting current-state processes and contributing to layout planning, material flow design, and production cycle data (e.g., cycle times, workstation utilization, and walking distances).

  • Support process design activities by helping to structure and document assembly processes for different vehicle variants down to individual work-step level.

  • Create and maintain illustrated work instructions for production processes.

  • Collect, prepare, and analyze process-related data using Excel.

  • Support qualification and training activities by maintaining workstation-specific skill matrices and preparing training materials for assembly teams.

  • Prepare and follow up on workshops and alignment meetings with external consulting partners, including meeting minutes, task tracking, and status reporting.



What you bring to the team:

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Logistics, or a comparable field of study.

  • You are proficient in using Excel and PowerPoint; initial experience with CAD or layout planning tools is a plus.

  • First practical experience in manufacturing, workshop environments, or through academic projects is welcome, but not required.

  • You work accurately and reliably when creating documentation and maintaining data, including recurring tasks.

  • You have a structured and independent way of working and are willing to take ownership of your tasks and follow up on topics proactively.

  • You communicate openly and professionally and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from Production, Engineering, and external partners.

  • You are available to work regularly on-site in Göppingen; the scope and duration of your engagement can be tailored individually.

  • You have good German and English language skills.

  • You have experience using AI tools effectively.

  • You are available to start immediately or by November 1st at the latest.

Why Quantum-Systems:

Wir glauben an die Stärke kombinierter Fähigkeiten: klare technische Expertise gepaart mit einer kundenorientierten Ausrichtung. Wir sind Branchenpioniere, die ehrgeizig, mutig und visionär sind. Wir überschreiten Grenzen, blicken über den Tellerrand und streben nach technologischer Exzellenz, um die Zukunft unbemannter Systeme mitzugestalten. Wir versprechen, dass wir Deine Startbahn für individuelles und berufliches Wachstum sein werden.

Our benefits:

  • Flexible working hours: With our trust-based working time model, you have the flexibility to manage not only your working hours but also your work-life balance independently.

  • Stay active: Through the EGYM Wellpass, you gain access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities, and we subsidize your membership.

  • Corporate Benefits: Take advantage of attractive offers and discounts from well-known brands and providers such as Adidas, Apple, and Expedia.

  • Team Events: We believe in growing together and celebrating our successes as a team.

About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

description_html:
Frankfurt am Main · Hybrid · Start ab sofort · 16–20 Stunden pro Woche

Stell dir vor, es ist dein erster Tag als Werkstudent:in HR bei ABRIO. Dein Team empfängt dich herzlich, dein Onboarding ist vorbereitet und beim gemeinsamen Team-Lunch lernst du deine neuen Kolleg:innen kennen. Schon bald hilfst du selbst dabei, weitere Talente für ABRIO zu begeistern.

Als Digital-Commerce-Beratung aus Frankfurt unterstützen wir führende Marken bei ihrem digitalen Wachstum. Im People-&-Culture-Team gestaltest du mit, wie wir passende Menschen gewinnen, neue Kolleg:innen begleiten und unsere Arbeitgebermarke erlebbar machen.

Dabei bringst du dein Wissen aus dem Studium ein, sammelst praktische Erfahrung im Recruiting und Personalmanagement und übernimmst nach deiner Einarbeitung eigene Aufgaben. Regelmäßiges Feedback unterstützt dich dabei, fachlich und persönlich weiterzuwachsen. Klingt spannend? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

DAS ERWARTET DICH

  • Talent Acquisition – passende Menschen finden und begeistern: Du erhältst durch deine Unterstützung im Bewerbermanagement und im Active Sourcing spannende Einblicke in die Welt des Recruitings. Dabei identifizierst du passende Talente und entwickelst kreative Ansprachekonzepte.

  • Talent Management – unsere Kolleg:innen begleiten: Du unterstützt unsere People-Prozesse vom Onboarding bis zum Offboarding. Du hilfst dabei, den Einstieg neuer Kolleg:innen vorzubereiten, Informationen übersichtlich aufzubereiten und organisatorische Abläufe zuverlässig zu gestalten.

  • Employer Branding – ABRIO als Arbeitgeber erlebbar machen: Ob Kampagnen, Mitarbeitenden-Testimonials oder neue Benefits – mit deinem Gespür für starke Ideen lässt du unsere Arbeitgebermarke glänzen.

  • Culture & Feel Good – Zusammenarbeit mitgestalten: Du bist an der Planung und Durchführung von internen und externen Events beteiligt und erstellst Konzepte, die unser Teamgefühl fördern und unsere Arbeitgebermarke stärken.



IT'S A MATCH, SOFERN DU...

  • eingeschrieben bist und dich mindestens im dritten Semester deines Studiums befindest – beispielsweise in BWL mit Schwerpunkt Personal, Personalmanagement, (Wirtschafts-)Psychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • unser Team mit 16–20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen kannst und dich auf die Zusammenarbeit in unserem Frankfurter Büro und im Homeoffice freust.

  • motiviert und lernbereit bist und dich schnell in spannende, verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben einarbeiten möchtest oder idealerweise schon erste Erfahrung in HR, Recruiting oder Employer Branding gesammelt hast.

  • ein Organisationstalent bist, ein Händchen für kreative Recruitingideen hast und du Lust hast, dich mit dem Thema Employer Branding zu beschäftigen und unsere Arbeitgebermarke zu stärken.

  • eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mitbringst und du dich selbst zugänglich und empathisch beschreibst.

  • sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen bist und gerne digital arbeitest.

  • sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringst.

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Teamspirit, den man erlebt: Offene Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und regelmäßige Teamevents sind bei uns fest verankert. Ob Team-Lunch, Afterwork-Drinks oder gemeinsame Aktivitäten – wir nehmen uns bewusst Zeit füreinander. 

  • Arbeitszeiten, die zu dir passen: Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und abgestimmten Präsenzzeiten gestalten wir gemeinsam eine gute Balance zwischen Studium und Job. 

  • Gestalte mit und wachse in Verantwortung hinein: Bei uns bekommst du die Unterstützung, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, dich weiterzuentwickeln und wertvolle Praxiserfahrung zu sammeln. 

  • Unsere Werte – gelebter Alltag: Teamgeist, Professionalität und Leidenschaft prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, übernehmen Verantwortung und wachsen gemeinsam. 

  • Modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts: Unser zentral gelegenes Büro mit moderner Ausstattung bietet dir Raum für kreative Ideen, konzentriertes Arbeiten und entspanntes Abschalten.

Benefits

Bei uns bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in die Arbeit hinter Ogaenics. Du sammelst praktische Erfahrungen, lernst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Marketing, Shop, Events und Kundenservice kennen und kannst herausfinden, wo deine Stärken liegen.

description_html:
Bei KOLLEKTIV K arbeiten wir mit viel Begeisterung und Leidenschaft an kreativen Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Wir lieben es, Emotionen zu wecken und nachhaltige Begeisterung für Marken zu schaffen. Zu unserem Kundenstamm gehören Marken wie Breuninger, Henkel, Tommy Hilfiger oder Douglas. Als junge, dynamische Agentur bieten wir Dir ein spannendes und abwechslungsreiches Aufgabenfeld, in dem Deine Kreativität und Dein Organisationstalent gefragt sind.

Aufgaben

Für ein spannendes Pop-up-Projekt vom 01.12. bis 23.12.2026 suchen wir motivierte und kommunikative Unterstützung vor Ort. In einem außergewöhnlichen Store-Konzept erwarten dich verschiedene Aufgaben rund um Gästebetreuung, Events und interaktive Aktionen.

Die Wochenarbeitszeit beträgt bis zu 40h. Je nach deinen Stärken und Interessen setzen wir dich in unterschiedlichen Bereichen ein.

  • Herzlicher Empfang und Betreuung unserer GästeUnterstützung bei Check-in und Registrierung
  • Betreuung und Erklärung verschiedener Aktions- und Erlebnisstationen
  • Durchführung und Betreuung von Gewinnspielen und Promotions
  • Unterstützung im Bereich Bar, Drinks & Hospitality
  • Begleitung von Events und besonderen Programmpunkten im Pop-up-Store
  • Unterstützung bei organisatorischen Abläufen vor Ort
  • Sicherstellen eines professionellen und positiven Gästeerlebnisses

Qualifikation

  • Du bist offen, kommunikativ und gehst gerne auf Menschen zu
  • Du hast ein freundliches, sympathisches und gepflegtes Auftreten
  • Du bist zuverlässig, verantwortungsbewusst und arbeitest gerne im Team
  • Auch in lebhaften Situationen behältst du den Überblick
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung in Events, Promotion, Gastronomie, Retail oder Gästebetreuung – dies ist aber kein Muss
  • Du hast Lust auf ein abwechslungsreiches Projekt und kannst dich schnell auf unterschiedliche Aufgaben einstellen
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Mitarbeit bei einem außergewöhnlichen Pop-up- und Eventprojekt
  • Einsätze im Zeitraum 01.12.–23.12.2026
  • Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten und unterschiedliche Einsatzbereiche
  • Zusammenarbeit in einem motivierten Event-Team
  • Spannende Einblicke hinter die Kulissen eines großen Marken- und Eventprojekts
  • Faire Vergütung auf Basis einer kurzfristigen Beschäftigung (Beachte: max. 70 Arbeitstage im Kalenderjahr möglich)
  • Möglichkeit für weitere Einsätze bei zukünftigen Events und Projekten

Interesse? Dann freuen wir uns auf eine kurze Bewerbung mit ein paar Infos zu dir, deiner bisherigen Erfahrung und deiner Verfügbarkeit zwischen dem 01.12. und 23.12.2026.

title: Sachbearbeiter/in Buchhaltung und Personalbüro (m/w/d) in Teilzeit
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at MANNER Sensortelemetrie GmbH
description_html:
Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir Verstärkung für unser kleines Team in der Buchhaltung und im Personalbüro. Sie arbeiten eng mit einer Kollegin bzw. einem Kollegen und unserer Seniorchefin zusammen. Wir stellen unser Unternehmen konsequent auf digitale Prozesse um und suchen jemanden, der diesen Weg aktiv mitgeht.

Aufgaben

Buchhaltung:

  • Sie prüfen ein- und ausgehende Rechnungen in unserem ERP-System und begleiten sie bis zur Überweisungsfreigabe
  • Sie sind in der Lage, offene Fragen selbstständig mit internen Ansprechpartnern oder bei Bedarf direkt mit dem Rechnungssteller zu klären.
  • Sie buchen Rechnungen, Gutschriften und Zahlungseingänge zuverlässig und termingerecht
  • Sie liefern die internen Daten für den Steuerberater für die Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse

Personalbüro:

  • Sie begleiten Ein- und Austritte von Mitarbeitenden (On- und Offboarding)
  • Sie unterstützen bei der Erstellung von Arbeitsverträgen für neue Mitarbeitende
  • Sie bereiten die Lohndaten für unseren externen Buchhaltungsdienstleister vor
  • Sie verwalten die Versicherungen unserer Mitarbeitenden

Weitere Aufgaben zur Unterstützung:

  • Sie betreuen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden
  • Sie unterstützen die Assistenz bei der Organisation von Firmenfeiern und Veranstaltungen
  • Sie gestalten die Digitalisierung unserer Abläufe aktiv mit

Nach der Einarbeitung

  • Sie übernehmen zusätzlich das Versicherungsmanagement des Unternehmens
  • Sie verwalten unsere Mobilfunkverträge/Mietverträge

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, z. B. als Kaufmann/-frau für Büromanagement oder Steuerfachangestellte/r
  • Sie bringen erste Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung mit, insbesondere mit Ein- und Ausgangsrechnungen, gern im Mittelstand
  • Sie haben ein gutes Verständnis für buchhalterische Zusammenhänge und arbeiten gern mit Zahlen
  • Sie sind ausgeprägt IT-affin, arbeiten sich schnell in neue Systeme ein und haben Freude daran, analoge Abläufe digital zu denken
  • Sie gehen sicher mit MS Office um, insbesondere mit Excel
  • Sie arbeiten sorgfältig, strukturiert und selbstständig
  • Sie sind absolut vertraulich und gehen verantwortungsbewusst mit Personal- und Finanzdaten um
  • Sie sind verbindlich, freundlich und kommunizieren gut mit Kunden, Kollegen und externen Partnern

Benefits

  • Eine unbefristete Stelle mit rund 20 Wochenstunden
  • Echte Mitgestaltung beim digitalen Wandel unseres Unternehmens
  • Ein neues ERP-System, das genau auf unsere Prozesse zugeschnitten ist
  • Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen bis zur Geschäftsführung und eine Aufgabe, die mit Ihnen wächst
  • Eine attraktive Vergütung mit Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprämie und E-Bike-Leasing
  • Einen Zuschuss zu den Umzugskosten

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

description_html:
• Turnover Recruitment ist eine spezialisierte Recruiting-Beratung für E-Commerce-Unternehmen.
  • Wir lösen Recruiting-Probleme dort, wo Standardlösungen nicht mehr funktionieren.
  • Jetzt bauen wir die Marke weiter auf klarer, sichtbarer und relevanter.
  • Dafür suchen wir die erste zusätzliche Person neben dem Gründer.
  • Keine klassische Werkstudentenrolle zum Zuarbeiten.
  • Du bekommst eigene Projekte, viel Verantwortung und direkten Einfluss auf den Markenaufbau.
  • Dein Spielfeld: Marketing, Brand und Content.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Gründer und einer spezialisierten Agentur die Branding-Struktur von Turnover weiter.
  • Du übersetzt unsere Markenstrategie in konkrete Inhalte, Formate und Maßnahmen.
  • Du baust eine skalierbare Content Engine auf – von der ersten Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung.
  • Du entwickelst Content für LinkedIn und weitere relevante organische Kanäle.
  • Du recherchierst relevante Themen, Trends und Diskussionen aus E-Commerce, Recruiting und Arbeitsmarkt.
  • Du nutzt AI konsequent für Recherche, Ideenentwicklung, Texterstellung und effiziente Prozesse.
  • Du testest neue Formate, Hooks und Themen – und wertest aus, was tatsächlich funktioniert.
  • Du entwickelst eigene Ideen für Kampagnen und jobbezogene Marketingmaßnahmen.
  • Du produzierst. Du testest. Du verbesserst. Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder Schritt vorgegeben wird.

Qualifikation

  • Eingeschrieben an einer deutschen Hochschule oder Universität – für mindestens weitere sechs Monate.
  • Relevantes Studium, beispielsweise in Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien oder Wirtschaft.

  • Gelegentliche Bereitschaft für Events + Coworking in Hamburg oder Berlin.

Benefits

  • Remote & flexibel: Arbeite von überall und teile deine Arbeitszeit flexibel ein.
  • Studium geht vor: Klausuren und Thesis haben Priorität. Arbeitszeiten können unkompliziert verschoben werden.
  • Echter Impact: Eigene Projekte, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Einfluss auf den Markenaufbau.
  • Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer statt klassischer Werkstudenten-Zuarbeit.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Praxisnahes Know-how in Brand, Content, AI, Marketing, Recruiting und Unternehmertum.
  • Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung: Attraktives Grundgehalt plus mögliche leistungsbezogene Boni.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Möglichkeit einer Übernahme nach dem Studium, wenn es für beide Seiten passt.

title: Employer Branding Manager (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at adjoe
description_html:
adjoe is redefining the future of mobile ads. Powered by advanced AI, first-party data and world-class engineers, we’ve perfected the offerwall experience for monetizing and scaling app publishers with solutions like Playtime and Arcade – now the fastest growing rewarded advertising channel globally – driving incremental engagement, retention, and revenue.

At the same time, we’re breaking into programmatic advertising with the intelligent bidding system of adjoe Ads. Together, this ecosystem connects app developers to over 600 million users worldwide for scalable growth. Backed by a $100 million investment from Bertelsmann and operating from offices in Hamburg, Boston, Singapore, and Tokyo, adjoe is defining the next stages of app and ad experience – right now. Join us.

Where Talent Ambitions Meets Product Strategy

The Employee Experience team designs and operates the programs and initiatives that shape how people join, grow, and perform at adjoe. The full employee lifecycle, built to support a high-performance organization ready to build ad technologies that reach every user on the globe.

The work sits at the intersection of people strategy and execution. On one side, designing structured programs that raise the bar: performance frameworks, development initiatives, and the onboarding experience that sets the standard from day one. On the other, building adjoe's employer brand externally — telling our story on how we solve biggest adtech challenges.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in employer branding, specifically within the tech industry.

  • You will define and evolve our Employer Value Proposition, showcasing real employee journeys and career development paths across video, podcasts, social channels, and external platforms. We are looking for someone who loves connecting with people and bringing authentic human and tech stories to life.

  • You will build and manage an active engineering blog pipeline and tech content strategy. You will partner directly with developers, tech leads, and directors to translate complex backend systems and tech pillars into engaging articles, stories, and social posts.

  • You will produce your own content hands-on while also briefing and directing designers, videographers, photographers, and content writers. You are comfortable scripting video concepts, leading shoots, and working closely with creative teams to deliver polished visual assets.

  • You will audit and refine our career website, external company profiles, and job description copy to ensure our employee experience, culture, and impact-driven roles are accurately reflected for global talent.

  • You will support developers in speaking at top tech conferences by helping build compelling presentation decks, abstracts, and talk tracks.

  • You bring a balance of big-picture strategy and daily execution. You are equally excited to map out long-term talent attraction campaigns as you are to jump on camera, write copy, or collaborate directly with an engineer to draft a tech piece.

What's in It for You?

At adjoe, we're designing the organization behind one of the fastest-growing adtech platforms in mobile. The initiatives you build, the talent you develop, and the culture you shape will directly influence how adjoe scales globally.

  • Go Big. Own programs that have real impact on how 250+ people across 7 offices join, grow, and perform.

  • Move Fast. Operate in a high-velocity environment where you design, test, and iterate on people programs with the same mindset as a product team.

  • Be Direct. Work in a culture where feedback is honest, collaboration is real, and your ideas get heard.

  • Thrive Together. Grow alongside a diverse, global team of 250+ people from over 40 countries — and help make that experience better for everyone.

  • Have Fun. Build meaningful programs, celebrate the people behind the product, and bring your energy to a team that genuinely enjoys what they do.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Product Builder
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Camunda
description_html:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

At Camunda, we are evolving how software gets built. We are looking for a Product Builder to help shape the enterprise and governance experience of Camunda Hub by combining product thinking, user empathy, UX judgment, and hands-on execution. This is a high-ownership role inside our Products organization for someone who wants to move quickly, work directly with customers and forward deployed engineers, and build in an AI-first environment.

Camunda Hub is the unified management platform through which teams govern their processes, manage access, and administer the platform at enterprise scale. You will join the Enterprise & Governance pod, which owns the surfaces enterprise Centres of Excellence and platform administrators rely on: access control and permissions, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance features, and the administration and configuration UI for clusters and platform settings.

The role will contribute across the full stack, enabling faster end-to-end product delivery.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Discover and clarify meaningful user problems for administrators, CoE teams, and enterprise architects by working closely with customers, forward deployed engineers, and internal stakeholders

  • Shape product direction through practical judgment, fast iteration, and a strong focus on solving the underlying problem rather than only implementing requests

  • Prototype, build, harden, ship, and iterate on product improvements across the enterprise and governance surfaces of Hub - access control, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance, and platform administration

  • Use AI tools effectively to accelerate first drafts, implementation steps, iteration, and learning while maintaining a strong quality bar

  • Work closely with other builders and product strategy counterparts to turn ideas into shipped outcomes, including across boundaries with Core / Identity where governance surfaces build on platform contracts

  • Improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of how the pod delivers product end-to-end

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • Experience shipping product directly in a software environment

  • Ability to work fluidly across product thinking, user experience, and hands-on delivery

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and turning open-ended problems into practical next steps

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in a remote-first, pod-based environment

  • Curiosity about users, fast learning loops, and a bias toward improving the product through iteration

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping product in a software context, not only coordinating roadmap or requirements

  • Strong AI-native delivery habits: able to use AI tools effectively for first drafts, implementation steps, and iteration, while reviewing and improving weak output rather than accepting it

  • Ability to describe and shape intended user experience clearly, including flow, hierarchy, states, copy, and accessibility expectations

  • Strong product and customer judgment: able to understand the user problem behind a request, use lightweight evidence and customer feedback, and make pragmatic decisions that create broader product value

  • Sound technical judgment within an established architecture, including the ability to test what was built, trace issues, understand frontend/backend boundaries, and contribute beyond a pure frontend scope over time

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with workflow software, orchestration, admin/platform tooling, or similarly technical product surfaces

  • Experience working in small, high-autonomy pods with broad ownership across discovery, design, and delivery

  • Familiarity with enterprise governance concerns: identity and access management, RBAC and permission models, multi-tenancy, audit logging, or compliance-driven requirements

  • Experience designing for administrator and platform-operator personas

  • Ability to capture validation learnings clearly, distinguish signal from noise, and help improve lightweight product validation practices

This role is an existing vacancy

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

United States: $119,900.00 to $193,200.00

United Kingdom: £75,300.00 to £123,800.00

Singapore: S$148,900.00 to S$223,300.00

Canada: to C$127,300.00 to C$209,300.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: DevOps Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sardine
description_html:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Location:

  • Remote - Germany

  • From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere!

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there.

About the Role:

As a DevOps Engineer at Sardine, you'll play a critical role in evolving our infrastructure and platform tooling to support a growing engineering team. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll drive key initiatives across deployment, observability, developer productivity, and cloud cost management.

You’ll work closely with application engineers, QA, and cross-functional stakeholders like Security and Finance to ensure our systems are reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient. The role involves building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, improving system observability, optimizing cloud usage through FinOps governance, and strengthening our platform’s resilience. While we have core tools in place, we’re looking for someone who can both own and elevate them by identifying gaps, improving automation, and proactively driving improvements.

This is an ideal role for someone who brings deep technical expertise, thrives in high-ownership environments, and is excited to shape the future of DevOps.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own and evolve our DevOps and platform engineering function, from build and deployment pipelines to monitoring, infrastructure as code, and cost optimization.

  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines that are secure, scalable, and built to support rapid product iterations without sacrificing stability.

  • Improve observability via Datadog, GCP, and custom dashboards, including FinOps focused observability outcomes.

  • Implement and maintain FinOps governance, including showback and chargeback models, to drive cost accountability across engineering teams.

  • Enable developer productivity by creating internal tooling, reusable modules, and simplifying infrastructure for other engineering teams.

  • Help teams define and measure SLOs setting the standard for how we think about system health and reliability.

  • Serve as a FinOps thought leader, collaborating with Product and Engineering to define the most cost-effective architectural patterns for new services and features.

  • Play a key role in shaping our engineering culture, DevOps best practices, and influencing our long-term DevOps roadmap.

  • Work cross-functionally with product engineering, security, finance, and other teams to align technical spending with business unit economics and financial goals.

What you'll need:

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or software engineering roles, ideally in high-growth startup environments

  • Proficiency in Python or Go, with strong software engineering fundamentals

  • Proven ownership of production infrastructure and platform tooling, with strong debugging skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems and diagnose unforeseen financial spikes

  • Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing highly secure and robust infrastructure, particularly in environments with stringent regulatory requirements such as those used by government agencies and major financial institutions

  • Deep experience with Kubernetes and tools like ArgoCD, Helm, and Terraform

  • Familiarity with GCP (preferred) or other major cloud providers, with a deep focus on cloud cost management, leveraging reserved instances/savings plans, and implementing cost anomaly detection

  • Hands-on experience with dedicated FinOps tooling (e.g., Kubecost, AWS Cost Explorer, GCP Cloud Billing, DoIT Cloud Intelligence) or building custom tooling for cost allocation and reporting.

  • Strong experience building CI/CD pipelines and internal developer tooling from the ground up

  • Hands-on experience with observability tools like Prometheus or Datadog, and participation in an on-call rotation

Benefits we offer:

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

  • Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door

  • One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

  • Monthly meal stipend

  • Monthly social meet-up stipend

  • Annual health and wellness stipend

  • Annual Learning stipend

Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.

To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice.

We're building the world's fastest way to design real, functional 3D parts. Kyrall's AI-powered design agent turns ideas into ready-to-manufacture 3D models in seconds. Backed by top European VCs, we're a young, well-funded startup based in Munich — and we're just getting started.

You'll work on our data team that owns the data our models learn from. That means sourcing 3D parametric data, writing parsers for CAD formats, and keeping the pipeline running so the AI team always has clean, usable training data.

What To Expect

  • Develop parsers that turn CAD formats into ML-compatible representations

  • Source, clean and structure 3D parametric datasets

  • Maintain and extend our data pipeline

  • Deliver datasets to the AI team and support their experiments

  • Studying computer science, engineering, mathematics or similar

  • Solid Python skills

  • Interest in 3D geometry, CAD or geometric data (B-Reps, meshes, point clouds)

  • Structured, self-driven way of working

  • 20 hours per week, on-site in Munich

Nice To Have

  • Experience with CAD software or libraries

  • Familiarity with data pipeline tooling

Why Kyrall?
We're reinventing how machines are designed and built, from the ground up. 3D modeling tools were the last major leap in this space, and the way we design parts today has hit its limit. You'll work directly with the founders and AI team on a small, fast-moving team — and see your work land in the product within weeks.

description_html:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich, the role will be based remotely or hybrid from Germany or Austria. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by blp.

 

About the role

As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you'll operate at the intersection of business and tech, leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You'll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.

 

What you'll do

  • Own the implementation journey end-to-end, from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

  • Translate complexity into clarity: design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

  • Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers' unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

  • Be the client's trusted partner: anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp's automation.

  • Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

  • Feed the product loop: surface what isn't working and translate that feedback into long-term platform improvements.

 

What you'll bring

Key attributes for success

  • Ownership and autonomy. You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

  • Managing ambiguity. You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

  • Growth mindset. You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

  • Problem solving and critical thinking. You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

  • Customer-first mentality. You think beyond implementation and care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills: you can translate business needs into technical action.

  • Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

  • Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus.

  • Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

 

What you'll get

  • High ownership environment. You shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale. Your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure. Work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth. Fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership. Be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team. Become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure. Be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits and offsites. Paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mindpeak
description_html:
Company Overview

Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized.

We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments.

What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare.

This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession.

You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes.

This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. You will personally run critical searches, source candidates, conduct interviews and close hires. At the same time, we expect you to help raise the quality of hiring across Mindpeak by challenging unclear requirements, improving interview practices and bringing structure and discipline to how we make hiring decisions.

You will not inherit a recruiting team, but you will have the mandate and budget to work with external recruiters and specialist search partners where they add value.

Your Mission

  • Own the full recruiting cycle: from search strategy, sourcing and screening through interviews, offers and closing.

  • Partner with our CEO and hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor: clarify requirements, challenge assumptionsand drive decisions forward.

  • Proactively identify and engage high-quality candidates, particularly for senior, leadership and hard-to-fill roles.

  • Run high-quality interviews that go beyond CVs and polished answers, uncovering concrete evidence of impact, decision-making and individual contribution.

  • Select, brief and actively manage external recruiters and search partners where they add value.

  • Keep pipelines, bottlenecks and risks transparent for leadership, and keep improving how Mindpeak hires without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What Success Looks Like

  • Priority searches run with clear role profiles and explicit assessment criteria, even when requirements start out ambiguous.

  • You successfully engage high-quality passive candidates and build genuine interest in Mindpeak and our roles.

  • Interviews across Mindpeak become more rigorous and consistent, based on evidence rather than titles or impressions.

  • Most importantly, critical roles get closed with people who raise the quality of the organisation.

Your Experience

  • Substantial hands-on experience owning full-cycle recruiting; a background in executive search or another environment with a strong sourcing and assessment culture is a plus.

  • Proven track record of closing senior, leadership and hard-to-fill searches, with strong active sourcing skills and confidence approaching passive candidates.

  • Experience in a technology-driven, high-growth environment, recruiting across functions such as Product, Technology and Business. You don't need to be technical, but you understand how these teams work well enough to recruit credibly.

  • Experience working directly with founders or demanding senior hiring managers and influencing their decisions rather than simply executing requirements.

  • Experience translating unclear business needs into clear role profiles, scorecards and structured interview processes.

  • Experience selecting and managing external agencies or headhunters.

  • Fluent English; German is an advantage but not essential.

Your Profile

  • You interview for evidence and have strong talent judgment. You can tell an impressive CV or polished answer from real evidence that someone will succeed.

  • You know what good looks like and can credibly bring that standard into an organisation still developing its own.

  • You challenge senior stakeholders constructively and communicate clearly and directly with executives, hiring managers and senior candidates alike.

  • You take ownership. When a search isn't working, you diagnose why and change the approach, and you know when requirements need to change.

  • You create structure without bureaucracy, just enough process to improve speed, quality and accountability.

  • You learn quickly and immerse yourself in unfamiliar domains until you can recruit credibly in them.

Why Mindpeak

  • Take real ownership of Talent Acquisition in a growing AI company where hiring exceptional people has a direct impact on the success of the business.

  • Recruit across some of the most interesting talent markets today – from AI and software engineering to medicine, science and commercial roles.

  • Work directly with our founders and senior leaders Shape and continuously improve how we identify, assess and hire exceptional people rather than simply executing a fixed corporate recruiting process.

  • See the impact of the teams you build on cancer diagnostics and treatment.

  • Work from our centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbor.

Application Details

Please send us:

  • Your CV and reference letters

  • Your salary expectations

  • Your earliest possible starting date

Note: Direct applicants only. We do not work with recruiting agencies for this position.

title: Founding Account Executive, Head of Sales Track (German-speaking)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Bowatt
description_html:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and system engineering software for manufacturing. We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across several complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.

 

We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

 

You’ll join a small, exceptional team of startup builders, driven by innovation and execution. Over half the team are former founders across DeepTech AI, psychedelics, and gaming. We’ve studied and worked at top institutions and companies like Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.

 

The role

  • Responsible for qualifying and closing new pilot customers, from large Mittelstand companies to Tier-1 enterprises in the DACH region and beyond

  • Run product demos tailored to each customer's specific pain points

  • Build the business case and quantify the ROI for each demo client

  • Own and manage your pipeline end-to-end

  • Develop deep expertise in BoWatt's software, customers, and target industries

  • Work with BDRs who help feed the top of your funnel

  • First 6 months: intensive training and close collaboration with the CEO to build the industry knowledge and context needed to succeed in the role

 

You

  • You are able to easily shake off rejection

  • You write clearly, speak confidently, and know how to get to the point

  • You are able to adapt and develop practical solutions for each situation - every customer has unique challenges and goals

  • You want to grow into a domain expert - software, customers, and industry

  • You are ambitious, proactive, and willing to go the extra mile to achieve results

 

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of closing experience in B2B software sales, ideally in an industrial or technical environment

  • Alternatively, experience in technical sales or other sales position at an industrial manufacturer

  • Experience working with CRM systems (e.g. Pipedrive) and sales metrics

  • 4 days per week in the office in Munich (Meta Office, Balanstraße)

  • Fluent German required; English is our internal working language

  • Manufacturing and/or startup experience is a bonus

 

What we offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience (base salary, plus uncapped commission)

  • Participation in BoWatt’s Founders Pool: 5–10% virtual equity package

  • 25 vacation days/per yr, plus public holidays

  • Company retreats

  • WellPass membership

The Founders Pool

BoWatt’s Founders Pool is a dedicated virtual-equity pool for a small group of early team members who take responsibility for building and leading a major part of the company.

 

We created it because we want the people building BoWatt alongside us to participate meaningfully in the value they help create. These are not narrow execution roles with finished playbooks. You will own your vertical with co-founder-like autonomy and accountability: setting the standard, building the function, and being responsible for its results.

 

As our founding Customer Success hire, you will participate in the Founders Pool (5-10%) and have the opportunity to build Customer Success from the ground up. The precise allocation, vesting structure, and plan terms will be discussed transparently during the interview process.

 

Interview process

  1. 30min Screening call (Nat or Malte)

  2. 1.5hr Sales Interview (CEO + team member)

  3. 1hr Culture fit interview (CEO + CPO)

  4. Offer and reference checks

We aim to complete the interview process within 14 days.

Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

This VIE is Alta Ares' commercial entry point in Germany — the largest defence market in Europe and one undergoing the most significant defence industrial expansion since reunification. Based in Munich, at the heart of Germany's defence industrial ecosystem (Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, ESG, MTU), you will support and drive Alta Ares' early-stage commercial development with German primes and institutional contacts.

You will map the ecosystem, build first-contact relationships, and support the Account Manager Germany in converting opportunities into pipeline. Germany's Zeitenwende is real, budgets are moving fast, and the demand for AI and C-UAS capabilities is accelerating. You will be on the ground at the right moment.

1. Market Mapping & Opportunity Identification

  • Map Germany's defence industrial landscape: primes, systems integrators, procurement bodies (BAAINBw, Cyber Innovation Hub der Bundeswehr), and innovation initiatives (dtec.bw, IDEaS-equivalent)

  • Identify partnership and integration opportunities aligned with Alta Ares' product suite: ISR, C-UAS, AI autonomy

  • Track German defence policy, Bundeswehr procurement priorities, and Zeitenwende investment programmes

  • Produce regular market intelligence reports for the Account Manager Germany and Paris leadership team

2. Relationship Building & Business Development

  • Initiate and develop first-contact relationships with BD, engineering, and procurement teams at target accounts: Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, Diehl, ESG, BWI, and equivalent

  • Represent Alta Ares at key German defence events: DSEI, ILA Berlin, Eurosatory, and industry forums in Munich and Berlin

3. Germany–Paris Coordination

  • Serve as the operational bridge between Munich and Alta Ares HQ in Paris

  • Coordinate logistics for partner visits, demos, and leadership trips to Germany

  • Ensure smooth communication across time zones and cultural contexts — translating not just language but business culture

Candidate Profile

  • 0–3 years of experience — open to recent graduates and early-career profiles

  • Background in business development, international relations, political science, engineering, or a related field

  • Prior exposure to Germany (studies, internship, or work experience) is a strong plus

  • German fluency — mandatory: your accounts are German industrial companies and relationships are built in German

  • English fluency — mandatory

  • French is a meaningful plus — daily interaction with Paris HQ

  • Genuine interest in defence technology, European security, and Germany's defence industrial ecosystem

  • Organised, proactive, and comfortable building relationships from scratch in a new market

  • Culturally agile: equally at ease in a formal German industrial setting and a fast-moving French startup

VIE Eligibility: French or EU nationality — mandatory. Aged 18 to 28 at mission start. No prior VIE with the same company.
